desc.en: Six semantic types, one class each: primary/info/success/warning/error (no class = default).
The fill treatment is a class too: outline / text / dashed (no class = solid), as are secondary and ghost.

Opt-in border light -- the `specular` class. A small symmetric pair of glints rides the button's border, brightest at the edge nearest the cursor and mirrored on the opposite side; it moves only when the pointer moves (no auto-spin, zero repaints when still), stays on the border so it never covers the label, and is clipped to the button so nothing spills onto neighbours.
A subtly tinted fill with type-colored text -- the `secondary` class -- for lower-emphasis actions.

Size is a class: tiny / small / medium (default) / large, so `button.small { height: 26px }` in a skin wins.

new ButtonGroup(type) welds buttons together with shared borders (rounded only on the outer corners). Add(label) appends a segment; Outline(true) for an outlined group; Render returns the clicked index or -1.

A flatter look than secondary: no border, transparent background, text inherits the role color. The `Tertiary` boolean prop is equivalent to `Class = "tertiary"` -- useful for actions that should sit quietly next to the primary one (Naive UI's tertiary button).

desc.en: Pass a brand colour as `Color = 0xFF1890FF` and the button auto-derives hover and pressed shades. No CSS needed -- the runtime injects `[class*="custom-"]` rules with Lighten/Darken variants into the active sheet, and the prop binding makes it reactive (change `vm.themeColor` and every button that binds to it updates).

Icon-only button: leave `Text` empty and set an `Icon`. Naive UI's `icon-placement` flips the icon to the trailing slot; we keep the leading slot to match the rest of the gallery. Use `circle` for a square, `round` for a pill.

Click is the obvious one; Button also surfaces Enter/Leave/MouseDown/MouseUp via the `On` event pack inherited from Control, and `WasClicked()` for poll-based hosts (ribbons, tool strips) that sweep a row of buttons every frame rather than wiring per-button handlers.

Bold the label without touching the skin. The `Strong` boolean prop forces `font-weight: 700` on top of whatever the skin says, so a primary button can shout a primary action without a new variant class.

Button is a retained Control declared with an object initializer -- new Button { Text = "Save", Class = "primary small" } -- added to a container (Panel.Row/Column or a Form), so layout is automatic: no x/y/width. Wire a handler with `b.Click += ...`. Every look is a CSS class (type, fill, secondary, ghost, loading, shape, size), so a skin restyles all of it and demos only compose.

desc.en: Construct with a hint, bind `.data` to a model field, Render each frame.
A password field masks the text and shows an eye toggle on the trailing slot -- click to reveal the cleartext while the cursor stays put.
The `size` enum maps to skin classes: tiny/small use `input.small` (height 28, font 12), large uses `input.large` (height 40, font 16). Default is medium.
The `clearable` boolean prop draws an X glyph in the trailing slot when the field has text and focus; click to clear, the same as Naive UI's n-input clearable.
The `autoselect` prop selects all text the first time the field is focused -- perfect for address-bar / 'click to replace' inputs (Naive UI autoselect).
`iconLead` / `iconTrail` add a glyph to the leading or trailing slot, reserving space so the text doesn't run under the icon. Password fields always show a reveal eye on the trailing slot regardless.
`Disabled = true` greys the field out and ignores all keyboard / click input; inherits down the parent tree so a disabled form group silences every child.
SetError(msg) draws a red border (from `input::error` part) and shows the message below the field; any edit clears it.
The `prefix` / `suffix` string props add fixed text around the edit area (URL host parts...), and `prefixIcon` keeps the leading glyph slot; the text never slides under them. Naive UI prefix/suffix.
`Loading = true` replaces the trailing slot with a spinner -- the field stays live while an async op runs (Naive UI loading).
ShowCount + MaxLen draw "current / max" under the box (99+ above 99); the cap is enforced per code point -- and per grapheme cluster when CountGraphemes is on (an emoji family counts as ONE).
`Filter` (Naive UI allow-input) rewrites every candidate before it lands; rejected text is never inserted and the caret stays put. Built-ins: Input.OnlyDigits / Input.NoSpaces.
`Round = true` pulls the border-radius to a pill (skin class `input.round`).

SetStatus(Control.StatusSuccess()/StatusWarning()/StatusError()) tints the border via the matching `input::` part -- success/warning/error semantic states without a message (SetError keeps the message variant).
`PassiveActivated = true` renders the field inert until Enter arms it, then it behaves normally (Naive UI passively-activated).
Clear/Focus/Blur/SelectAll/ScrollToEnd drive the field from outside -- bind a Button.Click to each; the demo log below shows which ran.
Placeholder shown while the field is empty (constructor).
tiny/small/medium/large (Naive UI size prop, maps to skin classes).
Show X to clear when non-empty + focused (Naive UI clearable).
Select all on focus (Naive UI autoselect).
Mask the text; trailing eye glyph toggles reveal.

Trailing slot icon name.

Fixed trailing text inside the frame (Naive UI suffix).

Hard char cap, 0 = unlimited; counted per code point (per grapheme with countGraphemes).
Draw "current / max" under the box, right-aligned (99+ above 99).
Count grapheme clusters -- an emoji family counts as 1 (Naive UI count-graphemes).
Pill border-radius (skin class input.round).
success/warning/error border tint via SetStatus; Error(msg) shows the message variant.

Field height in pixels (Render argument).

A single-line text field. Construct it with a hint, bind its `.data` to a plain model field for two-way editing, then Render(app, x, y, w, h) each frame; GetText()/SetText() also read and replace the value. Naive UI style props: size (tiny/small/medium/large), clearable (X button when text is non-empty and field is focused), autoselect (auto-select all on focus, for 'click to replace' fields).
Six cells by default; typing fills left to right, Backspace walks back through filled cells.
MaskMode renders each filled cell as a dot (or your MaskChar) — the code is still a plain string in the model.
Block stretches the cells across the whole width passed to Render, like a full-width form field.
readonly (focusable, never edits), disabled, and the warning / error border colors from the field status classes.
Groups splits the cells into runs with a separator drawn between them (antd: custom render / formatted display).
small / medium / large map to the otp.small / otp.large skin classes (same height tokens as Input).
Bind `.data` to a model field for two-way editing; Complete fires once when the last cell fills, so a Verify button can gate on IsFull().
Filter rewrites every candidate before it lands (null rejects the edit silently): digits-only or letters-only codes.
Number of cells (constructor arg or `length` prop; clamped >= 1, SetLength preserves the prefix).
small / medium / large (maps to the otp skin classes).
Render filled cells with the mask char instead of the value.
Mask glyph when maskMode is on (empty string falls back to '•').
Stretch cells across the full Render width (antd block).

desc.en: FormGroup turns every Add() into a field row (caption + control + error line) and Validate() runs each row's rules, painting the first failure inline: Input shows its own red border + message, everything else a `label.error` line under the field. Button-segment form (Element Plus el-radio-button).
tiny/small/medium/large, applied to every option.
Programmatic select (silent; disabled / out-of-range values are ignored).
Fires when the selection moves (signal-level, not per-option).
Fires when any option is toggled by the user (`g.OnChange(h)`).

A radio group container: AddOption hands each label to the group, the group measures and lays the options out, and rows wrap when the width runs out. Selected() is the group's shared SignalInt -- read it directly instead of binding every option to one field by hand (compare the raw Radio page).
desc.zh: 单选组容器：AddOption 把选项交给组，组负责测量与排布，宽度不够时自动换行成多行。Selected() 是全组共享的选中信号（SignalInt）——直接读它即可，不必像裸 Radio 那样逐个把选项绑到同一字段。

comps.json: {"type": "RadioGroup", "name": "ship", "options": ["当日达配送", "门店自提（旗舰店）", "快递柜投递"]}

comps.name: Switch

title.zh: 尺寸 / 方形 / 加载 / 禁用

desc.en: Every variant on one row: size is a class (tiny / small / medium / large -- tiny is Switch's own fourth tier), Loading dims the track and spins an arc on the thumb while a remote op is in flight, Round=false squares the shape, and Disabled greys the switch out and ignores clicks. The interactive switches all bind `model.toggle`, so the caption below reads the model field back live.
desc.zh: 一行看全所有变体：尺寸是 class（tiny / small / medium / large——tiny 是 Switch 独有的第四档），Loading 变暗轨道并在拇指上叠画弧线（远端操作进行中），Round=false 得方形，Disabled 置灰且忽略点击。可交互的开关都绑定 `model.toggle`，下方文字实时回读模型字段。

title.zh: 内嵌内容与自定义颜色

desc.en: Text or icons live inside the track on the free side of the thumb, drawn in the thumb's own colour and cross-faded with the slide animation; the track widens to fit the larger of the two states. Round=false squares the shape, CheckedColor/UncheckedColor override the skin off/on colours (0 = skin), and Loading keeps working on top of all of it -- spinner on the thumb, clicks ignored.
desc.zh: 文字/图标画在轨道内拇指的对侧，用拇指底色随滑动动画交叉淡显，轨道按两态较宽者自动撑宽。Round=false 得方形；CheckedColor/UncheckedColor 覆盖皮肤 off/on 底色（0 = 跟随皮肤）；Loading 可叠加其上——拇指转圈、点击失聪。

title.zh: 自定义选中值（int 字段）

desc.en: The switch can drive an int field instead of a bool: bind `.value` and say which value means "on" with CheckedValue / UncheckedValue -- the switch shows on exactly when `value == CheckedValue`, and flipping writes those values back. Values outside the pair read as off, and a Change handler can round-trip through a designer-friendly string model too.
desc.zh: 开关也能驱动 int 字段而非 bool：绑定 `.value`，用 CheckedValue / UncheckedValue 指明「哪个值算选中」——开关在「值 == CheckedValue」时为开，拨动则写回这两个值。绑定外的值一律显示为关。

desc.en: One switch silences a whole section: Disabled inherits down the tree, so `group.Disabled = !model.masterOn` greys out and deafens every child switch at once -- no per-child bookkeeping. The gallery syncs it each frame from the model; a Change handler on the master works the same.
desc.zh: 一个开关管住一组：Disabled 沿树向下继承，`group.Disabled = !model.masterOn` 一句就把子开关全部置灰并失聪——不必逐个记录状态。gallery 这里每帧从模型值同步；订阅总开关的 Change 再赋值效果相同。

desc.en: The settings-page pattern: each row is a card panel (title + hint on the left, the switch pushed to the end by a flex grow spacer), and a summary line reads the three model fields back live. The rows themselves are rebuilt every frame -- only the switches are retained -- so the layout is just data.
desc.zh: 设置页形态：每行是一张卡片面板（左侧标题 + 描述，开关用 flex grow 占位推到行尾），底部一行实时汇总三个模型字段的启用数。行本身每帧重建——只有开关是保留态——布局即数据。

desc.en: The loading prop doing its real job: flipping does not write the value -- the click is rolled back, Loading lights the track for about half a second (the simulated remote op), and the value lands when the op completes. Extra clicks mid-flight are rolled back the same way, so the little state machine has exactly one entry point and no event ordering to reason about.
desc.zh: loading 的真实用途：拨动不立即写值——先把点击回卷成「没点过」，Loading 点亮轨道约半秒（模拟远端操作），完成那一刻值才落地。操作期间的再点击同样被回卷，小状态机只有一个入口，不存在事件时序问题。

desc.en: On/off state (two-way): `sw.data = model.field;`.
Int binding axis (two-way): with checkedValue/uncheckedValue the switch means `value == checkedValue`; takes precedence over `data` when both are set.
Values written by the int value axis (Ant Design checked-value / unchecked-value).
tiny/small/medium/large → switch.tiny/.small/.large skin classes.
Thumb arc spinner + dimmed track; clicks and keyboard are ignored while on (Ant Design loading).
Pill track + round thumb; false gives the small-radius square shape (Ant Design shape="square").
Inner text per state; the track widens to fit (Ant Design children).
Inner icon per state (Gui.Icon glyph name, e.g. "check" / "close").
Custom track colour per state; 0 = follow the skin (Progress color= convention).
Fires when flipped (Render handles the click).

A toggle switch. Bind its `.data` to a bool model field; Render dispatches its own click and keeps the field in sync both ways. Props: size (tiny/small/medium/large → switch.tiny/.small/.large skin classes), loading (thumb spinner + dimmed track; clicks are deaf while it's on), round (pill by default, false gives a small-radius square), checkedText/uncheckedText and checkedIcon/uncheckedIcon (inner content -- the track widens to fit), checkedColor/uncheckedColor (0 = skin), and the int value axis: checkedValue/uncheckedValue with `.value` bound to an int field (or Switch.BindValue(signal, on, off)) so the switch means "value == checkedValue".
desc.zh: 开关。将 `.data` 绑定到 bool 模型字段；Render 自行处理点击并双向同步。Props：size（tiny/small/medium/large → 皮肤类 switch.tiny/.small/.large）、loading（拇指转圈 + 轨道变暗，加载期间不响应点击）、round（默认胶囊形，false 得小圆角方形）、checkedText/uncheckedText 与 checkedIcon/uncheckedIcon（内嵌文字/图标，轨道自动撑宽）、checkedColor/uncheckedColor（0 = 跟随皮肤）、以及 int 值轴：checkedValue/uncheckedValue 配 `.value` 绑定 int 字段（或 Switch.BindValue(信号, 开值, 关值)），开关表达「值 == 选中值」。

comps.name: Slider

desc.en: range turns the slider into a dual-thumb [Low, High] editor: data binds the low thumb, dataHigh the high one. Pressing the track grabs the nearest thumb and keeps it for the whole drag; thumbs cannot cross. The two input numbers share the same model fields, so slider and inputs stay in sync both ways.
desc.zh: range 把滑块变成双柄的 [Low, High] 区间编辑器：data 绑低柄、dataHigh 绑高柄。按轨道那一刻抓住最近的柄并在整段拖动中固定；两柄不会交叉。两枚数字输入框绑同一对模型字段，滑块与输入框双向同步。

desc.en: AddMark(value, label) drops a dot on the track with its label below (right side when vertical); dots and labels are clickable and jump to the value. stepMark (Naive UI step="mark") restricts every input -- drag, track press, keyboard -- to the mark values only; arrow keys hop mark to mark. Both sliders share one model field so you can compare free vs restricted.
desc.zh: AddMark(值, 文案) 在轨道上放一枚圆点、文字排在轨道下方（竖向在右侧）；圆点和文字都可以点，点击直接取值。stepMark（即 Naive UI step="mark"）把一切输入——拖动、点轨道、键盘——都限制在标记值上，方向键在标记间跳跃。两条滑块共享同一个模型字段，自由/受限一眼可比。

desc.en: vertical stands the track up: min at the bottom, marks' labels to the right, and the tooltip flips to the thumb's right side. reverse flips the track so min sits at the top (or the right end when horizontal). A vertical slider needs a real height -- Prefer/Grow in a layout, or RenderIn(app, x, y, w, h) in immediate mode.
desc.zh: vertical 让轨道立起来：min 在下、刻度文字排到右侧、气泡也翻到圆钮右边。reverse 把轨道调头，min 落到顶端（横向时落到右端）。竖向滑块要有真实高度——布局里 Prefer/Grow，立即模式用 RenderIn(app, x, y, w, h)。

desc.en: tooltip (default on) shows the value bubble while dragging or hovering a thumb; tooltip=false silences it completely. showTooltip keeps the bubble visible all the time (Naive UI show-tooltip), and tipFormat is the format-tooltip equivalent: a template where "{v}" becomes the value, e.g. "{v}%". The bubble renders in the deferred tooltip layer, so it stays above later widgets.
desc.zh: tooltip（默认开）在拖动或悬停圆钮时显示值气泡；tooltip=false 彻底关掉。showTooltip 让气泡一直显示（Naive UI show-tooltip）；tipFormat 等价 format-tooltip：模板串里 "{v}" 替换为当前值，如 "{v}%"。气泡走帧末统一的 tooltip 层，始终盖在后续控件之上。

desc.en: Disabled = true greys the whole slider -- track, fill, thumb, marks -- via the slider:disabled skin rules and ignores pointer and keyboard input. It inherits down the tree like every control, so disabling a form group silences its sliders too.
desc.zh: Disabled = true 通过 slider:disabled 皮肤规则把轨道、填充、圆钮、刻度整体落灰，并忽略指针与键盘输入。它和所有控件一样沿树继承——禁用一个表单组，组里的滑块一并失效。

desc.en: Range bounds (constructor).
Snap to N increments on drag + keyboard (Naive UI step).
Bound value within [min, max] (the low thumb in range mode): `slider.data = model.field;`.
Dual thumbs; value = [Low, High]. Bind data (low) + dataHigh (high); SetRange(lo, hi) writes both.
Range mode's high value binding.
Track stands up, min at the bottom; needs a real height (Prefer/Grow, or RenderIn).
Flip the track: min sits at the right / top end.
Restrict selectable values to the marks (Naive UI step="mark").
Value bubble while dragging / hovering a thumb.
Keep the bubble visible all the time (Naive UI show-tooltip).
Bubble template: "{v}" becomes the value, e.g. "{v}%" (Naive UI format-tooltip).
Arrow keys nudge (by step), Home/End jump to min/max.
Track width in px (Render argument).
Dragging or clicking the track updates data.
Fires when the drag gesture ends (pointer up).

A range slider aligned with Naive UI n-slider. Construct with (min, max); bind `.data` to an int model field for two-way editing; Render(app, x, y, width) each frame. Props: step (snap to N increments), range (dual thumbs, value = [Low, High] via data + dataHigh), vertical + reverse, marks (AddMark(value, label), clickable) with stepMark = Naive UI step="mark", value bubble (tooltip / showTooltip / tipFormat template), keyboard arrow / Home / End stepping, Disabled greys everything out.
desc.zh: 范围滑块，对齐 Naive UI n-slider。构造时给定 (min, max)；将 `.data` 绑定到 int 模型字段实现双向编辑；每帧调用 Render(app, x, y, width)。Props：step（吸附到 N 整数倍）、range（双柄，值 = [Low, High]，data + dataHigh 分别绑定）、vertical + reverse（竖放/倒转）、marks（AddMark(值, 文案)，可点击）与 stepMark（即 Naive UI step="mark"，只能取标记值）、值气泡（tooltip / showTooltip / tipFormat 模板）、键盘方向键/Home/End 步进、Disabled 整条置灰。

comps.name: InputNumber

desc.en: Prefix / Suffix draw static labels around the value (¥ 0, 0 %); they never enter the edit buffer, so parsing stays numeric. With Placement "right" both step buttons cluster on the right, leaving the suffix its own slot.
desc.zh: Prefix / Suffix 在数值两侧画常显标签（¥ 0、0 %）；它们不进编辑缓冲，解析始终是纯数值。Placement "right" 时两枚步进钮收到右侧，后缀单独占位。

desc.en: The bounds come from the constructor; buttons, arrows and typing all clamp. Empty hint boxes show the placeholder until a value is committed.
desc.zh: 取值范围来自构造函数；按钮、方向键、输入三条路径全部钳制。未输入时显示 hint占位。

desc.en: GroupDigits thousands-separates the integer part; Formatter / Parser are the Naive UI format / parse hooks (set both together) -- here they tack a currency suffix onto the display and strip it back off on commit. Thousands commas are stripped on parse even without a custom parser.
desc.zh: GroupDigits 给整数部分加千分位；Formatter / Parser 即 Naive UI 的 format / parse 钩子（通常成对设置）——这里给展示文本贴 ¥ 后缀、提交时再剥掉。即使不设钩子，千分位逗号也会在解析时剥除。

desc.en: Precision switches the int model to a fixed-point reading: the field holds value x 10^Precision (2 decimals: model 50 shows 0.50), step / min / max are in scaled units (stepV 10 = 0.10), and extra typed digits round half-up on commit.
desc.zh: Precision 把 int 模型按定点数读取：字段存显示值 × 10^Precision（2 位小数时模型值 50 显示 0.50），step/min/max 同按缩放单位（stepV 10 = 0.10），输入多余小数位提交时四舍五入。

desc.en: Loading greys the whole box, swaps the step buttons for a spinning dot ring and ignores pointer and keyboard -- the shape of a field waiting on a remote check. The switch shares model.numLoading with the box state.
desc.zh: Loading 整框落灰、钮位换成旋转圆点、指针键盘都不响应——等待远端校验时的形态。开关与数值框共享 model.numLoading。

demos.code:
InputNumber n = new InputNumber(0, 100);
n.Loading = busy;   // 远端取数进行中

desc.en: Check votes on the value about to be written: rejecting it does not block the commit, but the box paints the input::error red ring and fires Invalid until the next value passes.
desc.zh: Check 对将要写入的值投票：未通过不阻止写入，但整框画 input::error 红描边并触发 Invalid，直到下一次通过。去试试把值改到 10 以下。

desc.en: Range bounds (constructor); every write path clamps.
Bound value: `num.data = model.field;`.
Button / arrow-key step (scaled units when Precision > 0).
Button placement (Naive UI button-placement): "both" (default) / "right".
Static labels drawn around the value (Naive UI prefix / suffix).
Thousands separators on display ("1,075"); the edit buffer keeps the raw string.
Fixed-point decimals (Naive UI precision): model holds value x 10^Precision.
Custom display / parse hooks (Naive UI format / parse).
Custom validator: false marks the box error + fires Invalid (value still commits).
Greyed box, buttons swap to a spinner, pointer / keyboard ignored (Naive UI loading).
Size variant (small / large -> input.small/.large skin classes).
Value committed (button, arrow, Enter or blur).
Enter pressed while editing.
Check rejected the last committed value.

A number field aligned with Naive UI n-input-number. Construct with (min, max); bind `.data` to an int model field; the inline - / + buttons (or Up/Down keys) step by `stepV`, every path clamps to [min, max]. Props: Placement (button-placement: both / right), Prefix / Suffix static labels around the value, GroupDigits thousands separators, Precision fixed-point decimals (the model holds value x 10^Precision, so step 1 = 0.01 at precision 2), Formatter / Parser hooks (Naive UI format / parse), Loading (greyed box, buttons swap to a spinner, input ignored), Check validator (red input::error ring + Invalid event), Size (small / large), events Change / Submit / Enter.
desc.zh: 数字输入框，对齐 Naive UI n-input-number。构造时给定 (min, max)；`.data` 绑 int 模型字段；内嵌 − / + 按钮（或方向键）按 stepV 步进，所有路径钳到 [min, max]。Props：Placement（按钮位置 both / right）、Prefix / Suffix 常显前后缀、GroupDigits 千分位、Precision 小数位（定点数：模型值 = 显示值 × 10^Precision，2 位小数时 step 1 = 0.01）、Formatter / Parser 自定义钩子（即 Naive UI format / parse）、Loading 加载态（整框落灰、钮位换旋转圆点、输入忽略）、Check 自定义验证（红描边 + Invalid 事件）、Size 尺寸档；事件 Change / Submit / Enter。

comps.name: Select

desc.en: Choices shown in the popup (constructor).
Selected option index (two-way): `select.data = model.field;`.
Placeholder when nothing is chosen.
Fires when the selected option changes.

Retained dropdown. Bind() gives it a stable identity; it owns its open state and defers the option list to the framework overlay layer, so the popup always draws above later content. Change fires on select (C#-style delegate).
desc.zh: 保留态下拉框。Bind() 赋予它稳定标识；它自持展开状态，并把选项列表交给框架的覆盖层绘制，因此弹窗始终显示在后续内容之上。选择时触发 Change（C# 风格委托）。

comps.name: SelectBox

demos.json:
{
  "type": "Column",
  "name": "selects",
  "gap": 12,
  "children": [
    { "type": "SelectBox", "name": "city",   "hint": "Pick a city", "clearable": true,
      "options": ["London", "Paris"] },
    { "type": "SelectBox", "name": "filter", "hint": "Type to filter...",
      "filterable": true,
      "options": ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry", "Date"] },
    { "type": "SelectBox", "name": "top",    "hint": "Opens upward",
      "placement": "top",
      "options": ["First", "Second"] }
  ]
}

desc.en: Filterable(true) puts a search box at the top of the popup and narrows the list as you type; the X clears it. FilterHint sets the placeholder, FilterText()/SetFilterText drive it from code (remote search).
desc.zh: Filterable(true) 在弹层顶部加一个搜索框，键入即时收窄列表，X 清空。FilterHint 设置提示文字，FilterText()/SetFilterText 供代码驱动（远程搜索）。

desc.en: Table(headers, widths) turns the popup into an aligned table and AddRow(cells) adds one row per option -- each cell gets its own ellipsis, so the columns line up instead of one long concatenated string. The filter matches every cell, so searching by code or by name both work.
desc.zh: Table(headers, widths) 把弹层变成一张对齐的表，AddRow(cells) 每个选项一行 —— 每格各自收省略号，列因此是对齐的，而不是把几段文字拼成一条长字符串。筛选命中所有单元格，按代码搜和按名称搜都行。

desc.en: The popup walks only the rows inside the viewport and measures the widest label once, so the option count no longer costs anything per frame. Without both, 20000 options means 20000 iterations and 20000 text measurements every frame -- the measuring alone is more expensive than drawing the dozen rows you can actually see.
desc.zh: 弹层每帧只遍历视口里的行，最宽标签只量一次，选项数量因此不再有逐帧代价。两者缺一，两万条选项就是每帧两万次迭代加两万次文本测量 —— 光测量就比画出那十几行本身贵得多。

desc.en: Hover fires whenever the option under the pointer changes, and Hovered() says which one it is. The popup is placed by the framework (it flips when it would run off-screen), so a caller cannot work this out from the trigger geometry -- it has to come from the control.
desc.zh: 指针下的选项一变，Hover 就触发，Hovered() 给出是哪一条。弹层的位置由框架决定（越界时会翻转），调用方靠触发器几何算不出来，只能由控件报出。

desc.en: Cascade() turns the popup into linked columns: options built with AddBranch/AddChild expand one level per column, and picking a leaf writes the full path ("浙江 / 杭州") into the trigger. Text() returns that path; Selected() is the leaf's flat index. Reopening the popup auto-expands the selected chain, every column scrolls on its own (wheel + scrollbar), and ShowPath(false) keeps just the leaf label.
desc.zh: Cascade() 把弹层变成联动列：AddBranch/AddChild 建立的层级每列展开一级，选中叶子时触发器写入完整路径（"浙江 / 杭州"）。Text() 返回路径，Selected() 是叶子的平铺下标。重开弹层自动展开到选中链，每列自带滚动（滚轮 + 滚动条），ShowPath(false) 只留末级短标签。

desc.en: Multi(true) + Cascade() turns the rows into linked checkboxes: checking a parent checks its whole subtree, ancestors re-derive on the way up (all children = checked, some = dash). CheckStrategy decides what counts as a value -- CheckAll every checked node, CheckParent only the top of a fully checked subtree, CheckChild only leaves. CascadeLink(false) unlinks them (any level checks independently, branches directly selectable), HoverExpand expands on hover, Filterable searches the flattened tree by full path, and the trigger lays each value out as a removable tag chip that folds into +N when the width runs out.
desc.zh: Multi(true) + Cascade() 把行变成联动的勾选框：勾父带全部子孙，祖先沿父链重推（全子勾=勾、部分=短横）。CheckStrategy 决定什么算值——CheckAll 全部勾选节点、CheckParent 只算完整勾选子树的顶、CheckChild 只算叶子。CascadeLink(false) 解开联动（任何层级独立勾选、分支可直接选），HoverExpand 悬停即展开，Filterable 平铺整棵树按完整路径搜，触发器把每个值铺成可单独移除的标签芯片，放不下折成 +N。

desc.en: Tree() embeds a real TreeView in the popup: expand/collapse, scrolling and hover are all the TreeView's own behavior. Selecting a leaf writes its payload (or label) into the trigger.
desc.zh: Tree() 在弹层内嵌一颗真 TreeView：展开/折叠、滚动、悬停全是 TreeView 自己的行为。选中叶节点时触发器写入它的 payload（未设则 label）。

desc.en: AddGroup(title) inserts a non-selectable caption row; AddOption(label, true) adds a grayed-out option that ignores hover and clicks. While filtering, a group header survives only when something in its group still matches.
desc.zh: AddGroup(title) 插入一条不可选的小标题行；AddOption(label, true) 加置灰项，不响应悬停与点击。键入筛选时，组内没有命中项的标题会随组一起隐藏。

High-level select. Owns open/close, the popup (with its own clipping + scrolling for long lists), single- or multi-selection, an optional clear button, plus size and status variants. One Render() call does everything. Naive UI style props: filterable (popup gets a top search box that filters options as you type, with an X clear button), placement (auto/bottom/top -- choose the popup side), clearable (X inside the trigger to clear selection).
desc.zh: 高级选择框。自持展开/收起、弹窗（对长列表自带裁剪与滚动）、单选或多选、可选清除按钮，以及尺寸和状态变体。一次 Render() 调用即可完成全部功能。Naive UI 风格 props：filterable (弹层顶部加搜索框，键入即时过滤选项，含 X 清空按钮)、placement (auto/bottom/top 控制弹层弹出方向)、clearable (触发器内的 X 按钮清除选项)。

comps.json:
{

      "options": ["London", "Paris"] },

}

comps.name: Transfer

desc.en: WithSearchHints puts a search box under each panel head; rows filter as you type (case-insensitive substring on the row text), and select-all / move only see what the filter shows -- tick the whole city list, then search one letter and shuttle just the matches.
desc.zh: WithSearchHints 在两栏头部下各放一个搜索框：键入即按行文本过滤（忽略大小写的子串匹配），全选与移动也只看得见过滤结果——把整列城市勾上、再搜一个字母，穿梭过去的就只有命中的那些。

desc.en: 42000 items in one panel. Row painting is virtualized exactly like ListView: each frame walks only the viewport slice, so scrolling, filtering and shuttling keep the same cost no matter how long the list is.
desc.zh: 一栏四万两千项。行区与 ListView 同款虚拟化：每帧只遍历视口切片，滚动、过滤、穿梭的开销与列表长度无关。

desc.en: WithLabel turns the row text into anything the delegate returns -- here a member pick that composes the display label; WithIcon adds a row-leading glyph chosen per item.
desc.zh: WithLabel 让行文本变成委托返回的任何东西——这里用成员取值拼出展示文案；WithIcon 再给每行加一个按条目选定的行首图标。

desc.en: The host's own two List<T>; every frame reads them live.
Row text delegate.
Row-leading icon (Gui.Icon name, "" = none).
A filter input under each panel head; substring match, case-insensitive.
Drop the back button; right panel becomes read-only (rows not tappable).
Text instead of icons on the middle buttons (Ant Design operations).
Panel head wording.
Placeholder when a panel is empty.
Greys and deactivates the whole shuttle box (inherited down the tree).
Fires after items shuttle right / left (read Source()/Target() back).
Any side's checked set changed (row click, select-all, clear).
Tick-marked rows of each side, in row order.
Programmatic filter per panel (remote search); select-all and the middle buttons follow it.
Programmatic shuttle of the checked (filtered-visible) rows.

Two-panel shuttle box: tick rows on the left, shuttle them across with the middle buttons, tick on the right to move back. Each panel is an independent virtualized list (header with select-all / count / clear, optional search filter, checkbox rows, empty placeholder), so 42000 items cost the same as one screenful. Bind() takes the host's own two lists -- live views, no copy; row text comes from a CellOf<T> delegate and row icons from IconOf<T>.
desc.zh: 双栏穿梭框：左栏勾选后经中缝按钮搬到右栏，右栏勾选可移回。每栏都是独立的虚拟化列表（头部全选 / 计数 / 清除、可选搜索过滤、复选行、空态占位），四万项与一屏同开销。Bind() 直接绑宿主自己的两个列表（实时视图不拷贝）；行文本经 CellOf<T> 委托，行首图标经 IconOf<T>。

comps.name: Rate

desc.en: allowHalf splits every star into two hit halves: the left half sets i+0.5, the right half sets i+1, and the hover preview follows to the half (drawn as a 50%-alpha fill via rate::star-half). Half steps are *2-encoded in the model, so 7 reads back as 3.5.
desc.zh: allowHalf 把每颗星拆成左右两个命中格：左半 = i+0.5，右半 = i+1，悬停预览也跟随到半格（rate::star-half 画 50% 透明度实心）。模型按 *2 编码半格，7 读回来就是 3.5。

desc.en: clearable clears the rating when you click the icon matching the current value. The click is consumed exactly once (App.ClickAvailable), so clearing to 0 cannot be undone by the same release replaying on a later frame.
desc.zh: clearable 下点击与当前值相同的图标即清空。点击只被消费一次（App.ClickAvailable），清成 0 后不会被同一次释放的残留事件在后续帧写回。

desc.en: small / medium / large are rate.small/.large classes -- font and gap rescale together, and paint, measurement and hit rects all read the same step so clicks stay aligned. The three rows share one bound value.
desc.zh: small / medium / large 是 rate.small/.large class——字号与间距一起缩放，绘制、测量与命中矩形读同一个步长，点击不错位。三行共享同一个绑定值。

desc.en: The icon component draws every cell: icon is the filled-state name, voidIcon the empty-state one. Any known name works (star / star-empty are the defaults; heart, flame, like ... all resolve through IconSvg with IconVector fallback), so a skin restyles it and apps compose without drawing anything.
desc.zh: 每一格都由图标组件绘制：icon 是实心档名字，voidIcon 是空心档名字。任何认识的名字都行（默认 star / star-empty；heart、flame、like 等都走 IconSvg 解析、IconVector 兜底），皮肤可以整体换样式，应用不用自己画。

desc.en: Semantic accent classes recolor the filled state: rate.info / rate.success / rate.error set rate::star (and rate::star-half keeps half steps consistent). The three rows share one bound value so a change sweeps all accents at once.
desc.zh: 语义色 class 换实心色：rate.info / rate.success / rate.error 设置 rate::star（rate::star-half 同步跟进，半星不串色）。三行共享一个绑定值，一处变化三行齐动。

desc.en: readonly keeps the drawing (and the value binding for display) but registers no hit rects: no hover preview, no cursor feedback, clicks pass through untouched.
desc.zh: readonly 保留绘制（以及用于展示的值绑定），但不注册命中区：无悬停预览、无光标反馈，点击完全穿透。

desc.en: HoverChange fires when the hovered preview value changes and HoverValue() reads it (0 = pointer left; *2-encoded when allowHalf) -- the same number the stars preview. The label reads the model field the handler writes; LIVE STATES logs each transition.
desc.zh: 悬浮预览值变化时触发 HoverChange，HoverValue() 读取当前值（0 = 已离开；半星模式按 *2 编码）——与星星预览同一份数。标签回读处理器写入的模型字段，LIVE STATES 记录每次变化。

desc.en: Current rating 0..count (*2-encoded when allowHalf; two-way): `rate.data = model.field;`.
Number of stars (constructor).
Half stars: left/right half of star i = i+0.5 / i+1 (model *2-encoded).
Clicking the icon of the current value clears the rating (Naive UI clearable).
Drawn but not interactive; no hover preview (Naive UI readonly).
small/medium/large (Naive UI size; rate.small/.large classes).
Filled / empty icon names -- any name the icon component knows (heart, flame, ...).
Fires when a star is clicked (Render handles the click).
Fires when the hovered preview value changes; HoverValue() reads it (0 = pointer left, *2 when allowHalf).

An interactive star rating bound to a SignalInt. Icons come from the icon component (IconSvg first, IconVector fallback): set icon/voidIcon to any known name (heart, flame, ...) for a custom look; half-star mode splits each star into left/right hit halves so hover preview and clicks agree.
desc.zh: 绑定到 SignalInt 的可交互星级评分。图标走图标组件（IconSvg 优先、IconVector 回退）：icon/voidIcon 换成任何认识的名字（heart、flame 等）即可自定义外观；半星模式把每颗星拆成左右两个命中格，悬停预览与点击完全一致。

comps.name: ColorPicker

title.zh: 无透明度 / 锁定格式

desc.en: showAlpha = false hides the alpha bar and forces the value opaque -- rgb(r, g, b) / #RRGGBB. modes = ["hex"] goes further: the input-row tabs collapse to a single HEX entry and every value reads #RRGGBBAA. The label tabs on the input row still switch back within the allowed set.
desc.zh: showAlpha = false 隐藏透明度条，取值恒为不透明——rgb(r, g, b) / #RRGGBB。modes = ["hex"] 更进一步：输入行页签只剩 HEX 一组，取值恒为 #RRGGBBAA。输入行的标签页签仍在允许集合内可切回。

desc.en: Bind `.data` to a model field and the picker behaves like any other form control: edits flow back into the model, external writes (SetColor / SetText) flow into the panel, and Change fires once per committed gesture. The grey line below echoes the latest value text live.
desc.zh: 把 `.data` 绑到模型字段，选择器就和其它表单控件一样：编辑写回模型，外部赋值（SetColor / SetText）拉入面板，Change 在每次手势落定时触发一次。下方灰字实时回显最新取值文本。

desc.en: Current packed colour 0xAARRGGBB (two-way): `pick.data = model.field;`.
Value as text. Accepts #RGB / #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA and rgba()/rgb()/hsl()/hsb(); Text() reads it back in the current mode (SetExtra key: value/color/text).
Show the alpha slider; false hides it and the value is always opaque (Naive UI show-alpha).
Format of the value text: rgb / hex / hsl / hsb (Naive UI modes[0]; label tabs switch it live).
Restrict the selectable formats; a single entry locks the tabs and the value format (Modes("hex", "", "", "") or SetModes).
Trigger height tier via the colorpicker skin class (heightMedium by default).
Fires when a drag lands or an edited value is accepted; the model and two-way binding already hold the packed colour.

A trigger bar tinted with the current colour opens a popup: a saturation/value two-gradient panel, a hue spectrum bar, an alpha bar over a checkerboard, and an input row whose label tabs switch the format (rgb / hex / hsl / hsb, Naive UI modes). Dragging or editing commits through Change; the value is a packed 0xAARRGGBB (SignalInt / Binding<int> two-way). The popup uses the framework overlay layer so it draws on top of any later content.
desc.zh: 以当前颜色着色的触发条点开弹层：饱和度/明度双层渐变面板、色相光谱条、棋盘格衬底的透明度条，以及一行标签页签可切换格式的输入行（rgb / hex / hsl / hsb，对位 Naive UI modes）。拖动或输入经 Change 落定；取值是打包的 0xAARRGGBB（SignalInt / Binding<int> 双向）。弹层走框架覆盖层绘制，永久显示在后续内容之上。

comps.name: DatePicker

desc.en: Value string. Format depends on type: 'YYYY-MM-DD' / 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' / 'A ~ B' / 'YYYY-MM' / 'YYYY-Qn' / 'YYYY'.
date/datetime/daterange/datetimerange/week/month/monthrange/quarter/quarterrange/year/yearrange (Naive UI type).
tiny/small/medium/large (Naive UI size; input.small/.large tier heights).
Fires when the value (or one side of a range) changes.

An editable value box with a trailing calendar button. The popup uses the framework overlay layer so it draws on top of any later content. Naive UI type prop covers all 11 variants: date, datetime (hour/minute row), daterange/datetimerange (two side-by-side day panels, click start then end with a live hover preview), week (click any day to take its Monday..Sunday), month, monthrange (two 12-cell panels), quarter (Q1..Q4), quarterrange, year (a 12-year page) and yearrange (two pages).
desc.zh: 可编辑取值框，右侧日历按钮打开弹层。弹层走框架覆盖层绘制，永久显示在后续内容之上。Naive UI type 覆盖全部 11 种形式：date；datetime（底部时分行）；daterange/datetimerange（左右双日历面板，点起始再点结束，悬停实时预览区间）；week（点任意一天选中其周一~周日整周）；month；monthrange（双 12 宫格面板）；quarter（Q1-Q4）；quarterrange；year（12 年一页）；yearrange（双页）。

comps.name: Upload

desc.en: autoUpload = false: picked files pile up as Pending rows and nothing moves until Submit() -- one button to flush the whole list.
desc.zh: autoUpload = false：选进来的文件以「待上传」停在列表里，点提交按钮才整批开传。

desc.en: Change fires on every list mutation and Finish when an item lands; LastItem points at the file being talked about. The grey line below echoes the events live.
desc.zh: 列表每次增删触发 Change，某项完成触发 Finish，LastItem 指向被提及的文件。下方灰字实时回显事件。

desc.en: Pre-seeded rows via AddFile(name, path, url): with no transport they rest Pending, exactly the "restore the draft" view.
desc.zh: AddFile(name, path, url) 预置行：无传输通道时停在待上传，正是「草稿回显」要的形态。

desc.en: thumbnail = true: image rows blit a small cover thumb (thumb field, falling back to the local path); a mid-flight row keeps its progress bar.
desc.zh: thumbnail = true：图片行画小封面略图（thumb 字段优先，缺省回退本地路径），上传中的行保留进度条。

desc.en: CustomRequest takes over the transport entirely: the component has already flipped the row to Uploading -- you drive SetItemPercent/SetItemStatus from your own channel (here: a mock worker thread posting back through App.Post).
desc.zh: CustomRequest 完全接管传输：组件已把行标成上传中——进度与终态由你的通道推 SetItemPercent/SetItemStatus（这里用 mock 工作线程经 App.Post 封送回 UI）。

desc.en: SetFiles hands the component your List reference: buttons that add or clear files mutate the host's own list and the rows follow -- the state machine lives in the host.
desc.zh: SetFiles 把你的 List 引用交给组件：外部按钮增删的是宿主自己的列表，行跟着变——状态机在宿主手里。

desc.en: A Success file with a url renders its name as a primary-coloured link; clicking it (or the download glyph) raises Download with LastItem set -- wire that to your save/export flow.
desc.zh: 带 url 的成功项把文件名画成主色链接；点名字或下载图标触发 Download，LastItem 指向该项——接到自己的保存流程上。

desc.en: accept filters by extension before anything else; max caps the list and the overflowing picks fire Exceed instead of joining.
desc.zh: accept 按扩展名先行过滤；max 封顶，装不下的触发 Exceed 而非入列。

desc.en: dragger = true swaps the button for a full-width dashed zone; clicking it opens the picker and dropping files from the OS feeds the same gate chain.
desc.zh: dragger = true 把按钮换成整幅虚线区：点击开选择窗，从系统拖文件进来走同一道 accept/max 门。

desc.en: pictureCard = true: square tiles with cover-blitted previews, a trailing dashed add block, and hover masks with remove/download circles. Wall items use the gallery's own carousel assets.
desc.zh: pictureCard = true：方格封面缩略 + 尾部虚线「+」块 + 悬停遮罩上的移除/下载圆钮。示例图用画廊自带轮播资产。

desc.en: Built-in multipart POST target (http/https, optional :port). "" = no transport; items stay Pending. Attach via WithAction(url, fieldName).
Multipart form field name (WithAction second argument).
Extension whitelist, comma separated ('png,jpg' / '.png,image/jpeg' both parse).
Max admitted items (0 = unlimited); overflow raises Exceed with LastItem = the rejected file.
Start transport right after a file is admitted; false = manual Submit().
Batch picking/dropping.
Trigger button label.
Hide the trigger (list-only view for controlled demos).
Per-row x button (rows mode).
Per-row download glyph; click raises Download (LastItem = the file).
Whole-area dashed drop zone instead of a button (Naive UI dragger).

props.name: dragText
props.deflt: "点击或者拖动文件到该区域来上传"

desc.en: Dragger main text.
Grey hint line under the trigger.
Photo wall: square tiles + trailing add block (Naive UI picture-card).
Rows mode: image rows draw a small cover thumb (thumb field, else path).
Controlled mode: share your own list reference; every mutation repaints the rows.
File list mutated (add/remove/clear). LastItem = the touched file.
An item entered Uploading (alias of UploadStart).
An item reached Success (percent pinned to 100).
An item failed; LastItem.message carries the reason.
An item removed (x button or RemoveItem).
Name link / download glyph clicked; wire to your own save flow.
Max exceeded by an incoming batch.

File upload (Naive UI n-upload): a trigger button or a full dragger area feeds a file list with per-item status, progress, thumbnail, remove and download. Transport is pluggable -- built-in multipart HTTP POST via Action, a CustomRequest hook for your own channel, or pure manual Submit/SetItemStatus for controlled demos. BeforeUpload vetoes single files; accept+max gate the batch and fire Exceed.
desc.zh: 文件上传（Naive UI n-upload 对位）：触发按钮或整块拖拽区喂给一个带逐项状态、进度、缩略图、移除与下载的文件列表。传输可插拔——Action 内置 multipart HTTP POST、CustomRequest 钩子接管成自己的通道，或纯手动 Submit/SetItemStatus 驱动演示。BeforeUpload 单文件拦截；accept+max 把关整批并触发 Exceed。

comps.name: Card

desc.en: Header text.
Card width in px.
Card height in px.
Y where your body content should start.

Card draws a titled panel. Card.ContentY gives the y where your content should start. The preview shows opt-in motion effects that all draw clipped inside the card so they never shift layout or spill onto neighbours: BorderGlow (travelling border comet), Spotlight (cursor-follow glow), Sheen (diagonal light sweep), Aurora (drifting soft blobs), Breath (breathing rim) and Motes (rising dust).
desc.zh: Card 绘制带标题的面板。Card.ContentY 给出内容应当起始的 y 坐标。预览展示了可选的动效，全部裁剪在卡片内部绘制，不会挤动布局或溢出到相邻组件：BorderGlow(边框流光)、Spotlight(跟随光标)、Sheen(斜向扫光)、Aurora(漂移柔光)、Breath(呼吸边框)、Motes(上升光尘)。

comps.name: Panel

desc.en: Append a child (retained mode).
Paints a titleless surface; returns the inner content rect.

Panel is a titleless container surface (fill + border + padding) for grouping content. Use Card when you need a titled surface with a header divider. As a retained Control it auto-sizes and needs no coordinates.
desc.zh: Panel 是无标题的容器面板（填充 + 边框 + 内边距），用于分组内容。若需要带标题栏分隔线的面板请用 Card。作为保留态 Control，它会自动测量尺寸，无需坐标。

comps.name: Compose

desc.en: Give a container a title.
Flow direction for children.
Space between children.
Append a child node.

Fluent retained-mode composition: containers take children with a `Children = { a, b }` initializer, auto-docked along a Column/Row flow and auto-measured, so building trees needs no hand-computed x/y/w/h.
desc.zh: 流式保留态组合：容器用 `Children = { a, b }` 集合初始化器嵌套子节点，沿 Column/Row 流自动停靠并自动测量，因此构建界面树无需手工计算 x/y/w/h。

comps.name: Designer

desc.en: Ordered rows the form collects.
Label placement (top/left).
Control size for all fields.
Round-trip the whole form definition.

A reusable FormCreate-style form builder (stdlib Gui.Designer). Click a field type in the left palette to append a labelled row; click a row to select it; reorder/delete it from the toolbar. The right inspector switches between per-field properties (label, name, placeholder, required, options, change handler) and form-level config (label position, size, label width, required star, submit/reset buttons, submit handler). Save/Load round-trips the whole form (config + ordered fields + options + handlers); Preview hides the editing chrome.
desc.zh: 可复用的 FormCreate 风格表单构建器（stdlib Gui.Designer）。点击左侧面板中的字段类型即可追加一行带标签的字段；点击某行进行选中；用工具栏重排或删除。右侧检查器在“每个字段的属性”（标签、名称、占位符、是否必填、选项、变更处理器）与“表单级配置”（标签位置、尺寸、标签宽度、必填星号、提交/重置按钮、提交处理器）之间切换。Save/Load 可完整往返整个表单（配置 + 有序字段 + 选项 + 处理器）；Preview 隐藏编辑界面。

comps.name: Tag

desc.en: Tag label.
0 default, 1 primary, 2 info, 3 success, 4 warning, 5 error.
Show trailing X close glyph (Naive UI closable).
Click toggles Checked -- tag becomes a filter chip (Naive UI checkable).
Selected state for checkable tags (Naive UI checked).
Draws an x; returns the close hit id for Ui.Clicked.
Fires when the X glyph is clicked.
Fires when a checkable tag is toggled.

Tag draws a small coloured chip. The last argument selects the colour variant (0 default, 1 primary, 2 info, 3 success, 4 warning, 5 error). RenderClosable adds an x and returns its hit id so you can remove the tag on click. Naive UI style: `closable` boolean, `checkable` (click toggles Checked, skin uses `tag:selected`), `round` (skin class).
desc.zh: Tag 绘制一个彩色小标签。最后一个参数选择颜色变体（0 默认，1 primary，2 info，3 success，4 warning，5 error）。RenderClosable 会加上一个关闭“x”，并返回其命中 id，便于点击时移除该标签。Naive UI 风格：`closable` 布尔、`checkable` (点击切换 Checked，皮肤用 `tag:selected` 状态)、`round` (皮肤类)。

comps.name: DynamicTags

desc.en: |-joined tag texts (designer serialization).
Each tag shows a trailing x (Naive UI closable).
Tag count cap; 0 = unlimited; the trigger greys out at the cap.
Trigger label; empty follows the UI language.
Inline input placeholder.
tiny/small/medium/large.
Fires when a tag is added or removed.

Editable tag row: the dashed '+ Add' trigger turns into an inline input; Enter or an outside click commits (Naive UI n-dynamic-tags), each tag's x removes it, Max caps the count and greys the trigger out.
desc.zh: 可编辑标签行：虚线「+ 新建标签」触发器点击后原位变成输入框，回车或点击别处提交、Esc 放弃（Naive UI n-dynamic-tags）；标签尾部的 x 移除该条；Max 限制数量，达到后触发器置灰。

desc.en: An Avatar centres its initials; Size is the circle diameter in CSS px.

demos.code:
new Avatar("A", 32, "").RenderAt(app, 40, 40);
new Avatar("Z", 42, "").RenderAt(app, 100, 40);

desc.en: An Avatar with an Icon draws that glyph instead of text.

demos.code:
new Avatar("", 42, "user").RenderAt(app, 40, 40);
new Avatar("", 42, "settings").RenderAt(app, 112, 40);

desc.en: The `Shape` enum controls the outer rounding: `circle` (default, d/2), `rounded` (theme borderRadiusMedium), `square` (zero radius). Skin-class 'primary' applies the role colour.
Diameter in px.
Initial shown (Render).
Icon name (RenderWithIcon).
circle/rounded/square (Naive UI shape).
A circular avatar showing either a text initial or a named icon. size sets the diameter. Naive UI style props: shape (circle/rounded/square), size (diameter in px).
Badge.Dot(app, x, y) marks an unread or active state without a number.

demos.code: Badge.Dot(app, 40, 40);

desc.en: Badge.CountAt(app, x, y, n) shows a number; large values are capped with a plus.
Number shown (Count); Dot() has no count.
A small status marker placed next to another control: a plain dot or a numeric count.
A base64 data URI (PNM bytes synthesized in code) and an inline SVG data URI -- both decode in memory, nothing touches disk.

One source, four fits in 170x110 boxes laid out as Flex columns: contain letterboxes, cover crops to fill, fill stretches, none draws at natural size centred. Each caption is a plain Label -- the whole demo is a component tree, nothing is hand-drawn.

An http(s) src fetches on a background thread and marshals the bytes back through App.Post; a loopback HttpServer serves /img.pnm and /photo.jpeg so the demo runs offline. The 64KB photo arrives through the byte-safe HttpClient path (binary bodies survive embedded NUL bytes) into a 560x300 contain box; while loading and on failure the image shows its Alt placeholder.

A real 600x415 photo in generous aspect-mismatched boxes. Cover crops exactly one axis: a box wider than the photo crops top/bottom, a taller box crops the sides, and the crop rect stays centred. Contain letterboxes with a symmetric margin. Every cell is a Flex column of Image + caption Label.

The same photo shrunk to four aspect-true sizes (360/240/160/80 wide). Shrinking averages every covered source pixel (box filter), so thin lines and text survive at thumbnail sizes -- the previous nearest sampler dropped whole source columns and shimmered on motion. Growing or 1:1 stays nearest on pixel centres.

A Carousel whose slides are real Image components embedded with AddSlideView: the carousel manages layout, clipping, the slide transition and the arrows/dots, while each slide keeps the full Image address semantics (path / data URI / URL / SVG) and cover-crops to the 640x360 frame. Autoplay advances every 3.5s, mirroring the naive-ui carousel demo.
The four bundled photos cover-cropped into uniform 200x140 tiles on a wrapping Flex row -- narrow windows reflow instead of clipping.
File path, http(s) URL, data URI or SVG.
Placeholder / accessibility text.
contain/cover/fill/none.
Image decoded and cached.
Decode or fetch failed.

Pass an address, get a picture. Src understands local file paths (PNG/JPEG/BMP/GIF/TGA/PNM/PSD/WebP, plus .svg vector files), http(s):// URLs fetched on a background thread, data:image/...;base64,... payloads decoded in memory, and SVG from any of those sources (parsed and rasterized, re-rastered when the box size changes). Fit selects contain/cover/fill/none; Alt fills the loading and error placeholder; Loaded/Error report the outcome.
A draft document with a multi-line watermark on top. The watermark is the last child of the panel and grows to fill it; every tile rotates about its own centre, so the pitch stays a clean grid.
Color/FontPx/Rotate/GapX/GapY are plain properties: a brand-blue (18% alpha) horizontal STAGING tiling with a tight gap reads like table ruling.

Every knob on one panel, wired live: content (\n splits tile lines), font size / weight / colour, rotate, line height, explicit tile box with in-box text alignment, gap X/Y, offset X/Y, and whether tiles cross the watermark's own boundary. The panel controls are retained and two-way bound to model fields; the watermark is rebuilt from those fields every frame, so the preview follows the controls with zero event plumbing. Colour text accepts 0xAARRGGBB, #RRGGBB or bare RRGGBB (30% alpha); clearing it falls back to the built-in faint black.
desc.zh: 水印的全部旋钮摆在一块面板上实时联动：内容（\n 分行）、字号/字重/颜色、旋转角、行高、显式贴片盒与盒内对齐、X/Y 间隔、X/Y 偏移、是否跨越边界。面板控件保留态、双向绑到模型字段；水印每帧按字段现造——预览即改即见，一行事件代码都不用接。颜色文本接受 0xAARRGGBB、#RRGGBB 或裸 RRGGBB（30% alpha）；清空则回退内置淡黑。

desc.en: Watermark text; \n splits tile lines.
Image tile source; replaces text when set.
0xAARRGGBB; 0 = CSS color, then faint black.
0 = CSS font-size, then 14.
Degrees, positive clockwise; text only.
Horizontal tile pitch gap (logical px).
Vertical tile pitch gap (logical px).
Whole-layer horizontal shift.
Whole-layer vertical shift.
Per-line box height in px; 0 = font line height.

Explicit tile height; 0 = lines * line height.
left/center/right within the tile box (TileW > 0).
>= 600 double-strikes each line (simulated bold).
Tiles keep tiling past the control's own rect.

A translucent tiling overlay that marks a page's state (internal, draft, staging, tenant name) without touching the content underneath. Add it as the LAST child of a panel and Grow()/DockFill() it: children paint in order, so the watermark ends up on top while still passing clicks through (it registers no hit region). Content supports \n multi-line tiles rotated rigidly as a group; Rotate is degrees, positive = clockwise (default -22); GapX/GapY space the tiles; OffsetX/OffsetY shift the whole layer; Color is 0xAARRGGBB (alpha blends; 0 falls back to the CSS color, then the built-in faint black); FontPx 0 follows CSS font-size. LineHeight overrides the per-line box (0 = font line height); TileW/TileH force an explicit tile box (0 = measured) that TextAlign (left/center/right) aligns lines within; Weight >= 600 double-strikes each line for simulated bold. NoClip = true lets tiles spill past the control's own rect (clipped only by ancestors). Src points at an image (file or mem: key) instead of text -- bitmap tiles are drawn as-is, so bake any tilt into the pixels.

comps.name: Statistic

desc.en: Descriptive caption.
Highlighted value.
Show a highlighted numeric value with a descriptive label.
desc.zh: 以醒目的数值配合说明文字进行展示。

comps.code: new Statistic("Active users", "12,480").RenderAt(app, 40, 60);

comps.name: Countdown

desc.en: Restart() re-arms the timer; toggling Active pauses and resumes without losing the remainder. The status line is fed by Finish.
desc.zh: Restart() 重新摆表；切换 Active 暂停/恢复，剩余值不丢。状态行由 Finish 驱动。

desc.en: Five countdowns run at once at mixed cadences: three centisecond widgets repaint at the 60 fps display cap, one tenths, one seconds-only. Each one invalidates only its own strip, so the skin-FX background keeps animating in between.
desc.zh: 五只倒计时同时走动、节奏各异：三只百分位按 60fps 显示帧率封顶重绘，一只十分位、一只秒级。每只只失效自己的条带，背景皮肤特效在间隙里照常推进。

desc.en: Role classes recolor the progress bar through countdown.success/warning/error::fill; the large class scales the digits, small tightens them. Paused and finished countdowns resolve the disabled skin, dimming digits, border and bar together.
desc.zh: 角色类经 countdown.success/warning/error::fill 给进度条换色；large 档放大数字、small 档收紧。暂停与归零落到 disabled 皮肤，数字、边框与进度条一起降调。

desc.en: Real layouts stack a caption and the widget into a Panel column, and format tokens may carry literal text -- "D 天 HH:mm:ss" reads like a sentence. Wide horizontal space is where the card + progress bar shape earns its keep.
desc.zh: 真实布局把说明文案与控件叠进 Panel 列，格式令牌里可以夹字面量——"D 天 HH:mm:ss" 读起来像一句话。横向空间充裕时最能体现卡片 + 进度条形态的价值。

desc.en: Total length in ms; changing it re-arms the countdown.
false pauses; true resumes.
Tokens: D, HH, mm, ss, S, SS; other chars are literal.
The countdown reached zero (once per run).

Count down from a duration to zero and fire Finish. Active pauses/resumes with the remainder preserved; Format picks the displayed units with tokens D, HH, mm, ss, S (tenths) and SS (centiseconds, repainted at the 60 fps display cap, not 100 Hz); anything else is literal text.
desc.zh: 从一个时长倒数到零并触发 Finish。Active 暂停/恢复且剩余值不丢；Format 用令牌 D、HH、mm、ss、S（十分之一秒）、SS（百分之一秒，按显示帧率 60fps 封顶重绘而非每秒 100 次）选择显示位面，其余字符原样输出。

comps.name: NumberAnimation

desc.en: Restart() replays from the current From; the status line is fed by Finish, so every landing speaks once.
desc.zh: Restart() 从当前 From 重播；状态行由 Finish 驱动，每次到位恰好说一次。

desc.en: Precision pads fixed decimals -- the value is scaled, so 2400 at precision 2 reads 24.00.
desc.zh: precision 补足固定小数位——数值是 scaled 的，2400 在精度 2 下读作 24.00。

demos.code:
NumberAnimation price = new NumberAnimation(0, 2400, 1500);
price.Precision = 2;   // -> 24.00

desc.en: The button toggles the thousands separator between "," and "" (grouping off). Changing Separator does NOT re-arm -- only the display refreshes.
desc.zh: 按钮在 "," 与 ""（关闭分组）之间切换分隔符。改 Separator 不重摆——只刷新显示。

desc.en: Russian reads 699 700,699: space groups thousands, comma is the decimal point. Both strings are fully configurable -- there is no hardcoded separator anywhere.
desc.zh: 俄语读作 699 700,699：空格做千分位、逗号做小数点。两个字符都可配，哪里都没有写死的分隔符。

desc.en: Send a message when the animation completes -- Finish fires exactly once per run, so wiring it to a toast never double-fires on repaint.
desc.zh: 动画完成之后发个消息——Finish 每轮恰触发一次，挂到提示上不会被重绘重复触发。

desc.en: End value in scaled units (display * 10^Precision). Changing it re-arms and replays.
Start value in scaled units.
Roll length in ms (clamped >= 1); changing it re-arms.
false pauses (freeze the current value); true resumes without a jump.
Decimal places 0..6 (display only, does not re-arm).
Thousands separator; "" disables grouping.
Decimal point string (ru-RU uses ",").
Text before the number (e.g. currency sign).
Text after the number (e.g. " 条群消息").
The roll landed on To (once per run).

Roll a number from From to To with easing and fire Finish when it lands. Values are scaled integers (display x 10^Precision), so precision, the thousands separator and a custom decimal point (ru-RU: space groups, comma separates) all stay in pure integer math; Prefix/Suffix affix units.
desc.zh: 把数字从 From 缓动滚到 To，到位触发 Finish。数值是 scaled 定点整数（显示值 × 10^Precision），精度、千分位分隔符与自定义小数点（俄语：空格分组、逗号做小数点）全部在整数域推导；Prefix/Suffix 贴单位。

comps.name: QrCode

desc.en: Type any URL or text, cycle L/M/Q/H, toggle the logo and resize -- the info line reads back the model / module grid / effective level.
desc.zh: 任意输入网址或文本，L/M/Q/H 轮换，logo 一键开关，尺寸可加减——信息行回读模型/模块格数/生效级别。

desc.en: The same URL at all four levels: higher levels carry more Reed-Solomon codewords (denser grid) so the code survives more damage -- roughly 7/15/25/30% of codewords restorable.
desc.zh: 同一网址四档级别：级别越高纠错码字越多（格数越密），可恢复约 7%/15%/25%/30% 的码字损伤。

desc.en: Dark / Light take 0xAARRGGBB colours (0 falls back to the CSS qrcode rule); a 深底反相 code still scans as long as light modules stay on a quiet-zone border.
desc.zh: Dark/Light 收 0xAARRGGBB（0 交 CSS qrcode 规则）；深底反相只要留白仍是浅色边界，扫码照样通过。

desc.en: The logo punches a light plate over the modules, so the encoder auto-raises correction to H (layui does the same). Keep it <= ~25% for reliable scans.
desc.zh: logo 会盖出一块浅色衬底，编码器自动把纠错升到 H（layui 同款行为）；建议占比 ≤25% 保证可扫。

title.zh: svg 渲染 / PNG 下载

desc.en: ToSvg() returns the vector source (write it and show it in an Image); SavePng(path) assembles a real 8-bit RGB PNG in pure Zan -- zlib IDAT, per-chunk CRC32 -- ready to share.
desc.zh: ToSvg() 出矢量源（落盘交给 Image 显示）；SavePng(path) 纯 Zan 组装 8-bit RGB PNG——zlib IDAT、逐块 CRC32——直接可分享。

desc.en: Encoded content (UTF-8 byte mode; URL / text / digits).
Error-correction level: L / M / Q / H.
Edge length in logical px; 0 = CSS box / auto from module count.
Module colour 0xAARRGGBB; 0 = CSS color.
Background colour 0xAARRGGBB; 0 = CSS background-color.
Quiet-zone margin in modules (0..16).
Centre logo (image path); forces error level H.
Logo edge as % of the code (1..30).
Fires when the encoded content or properties change.

ISO/IEC 18004 QR code, models 1-40: mixed numeric/alphanumeric/byte segments, Reed-Solomon error correction L/M/Q/H, mask penalty scoring, colour customisation, centre logo (auto-raises to H), and pure-Zan SVG / PNG export.
desc.zh: ISO/IEC 18004 二维码，模型 1-40：数字/字母/字节混合分段、Reed-Solomon 纠错 L/M/Q/H、掩码罚分选优、颜色自定义、中心 logo（自动升 H）、纯 Zan 的 SVG / PNG 导出。

comps.name: Timeline

desc.en: 条目；可选 cls（语义角色）、icon（自定义图标）、pending（虚线尾+空心圈）。
大小档：small / medium / large。
形态类：horizontal 横排、right 轴线镜像到右。
Display ordered events with titles and descriptions.
desc.zh: 按顺序展示带标题和描述的事件时间线。

Row labels.
Render a compact vertical list of strings.

desc.en: Rows (SetItems); any size.
Viewport width in px.
Viewport height in px.
Selected row index, or -1.
Row clicked this frame, or -1.

High-level virtualized list: a fixed-height viewport over an arbitrarily large item list that draws ONLY the visible rows (constant cost for 100k rows). Owns pixel scrolling, the scrollbar and hover/selection by composing a ScrollView. Use this instead of ListView for large data.
desc.zh: 高级虚拟化列表：在任意大的数据集上使用固定高度视口，只绘制可见行（即使 10 万行也是常量开销）。通过组合 ScrollView 自带像素级滚动、滚动条与悬停/选中。大数据量时请用它替代 ListView。

Alternate-row background (RenderRow).

Row data (Push per cell).
Sort/filter/group/edit state (retained).
Freeze a column to the left / right edge; it keeps its place while the middle pans.
Allow inline edit (F2).
Per-column display formatting.
Footer aggregation for a numeric column.
Row/cell colours + custom cell paint (subclass, see below).
Name a column; DataTable.Col(cols, name) resolves it to an index.
Show the "click to add" line under the last row (needs src.CanInsert).
Journal cap; a grouped change (paste, multi-delete) is one Ctrl+Z.

Right-click a header cell (read HitCol).
