Selected-row set changed.
Virtual row window scrolled (read ScrollTop).

A stateful table with typed columns, multi-column sort, grouping, columns frozen to either edge, per-column display formatting, inline editing, row add/delete with undo, footer aggregation, drag-to-reorder, filtering, range charts, CSV export and a CellStyler hook for row/cell colours and hand-drawn cells.
desc.zh: 带状态的表格：类型化列、多列排序、分组、左右两侧列冻结、按列显示格式、内联编辑、增删行与撤销、底部聚合、拖拽换列、筛选、区域出图、CSV 导出，以及用于行/单元格着色与自绘单元格的 CellStyler 钩子。

comps.name: DataTable 1M

desc.en: Virtual source: RowCount/CellText/CellNum, no row storage.
70 columns; pans via scrollX (Shift+wheel / bar).
Per-column total; Derived columns compute from other aggregates.
Virtual row + horizontal column window.

A DataTable over millions of rows x 70 columns via a virtual DataSource: cells are fetched on demand for the visible window, so memory stays flat and every frame is constant-cost. Sorting uses typed keys; the summary row totals in one pass with derived columns computed from the aggregates.
desc.zh: 通过虚拟数据源承载数百万行 x 70 列的 DataTable：仅按需取可见窗口的单元格，内存恒定、每帧开销恒定。排序使用类型化键；合计行一趟汇总，派生列直接由聚合值计算。

comps.name: PivotTable

desc.en: Row/column fields, measures, rowSort, groupDigits, heat.
Retained scroll/selection/click state (keep across frames).
Source rows to summarize.
One or more measures: field + agg (0 sum/1 count/2 avg/3 max/4 min) + showAs (0 abs/1 %row/2 %col/3 %grand) + title.
Cross-tab with scrolling, pinned totals, full-row hover, click selection, % of row/col/grand measures, heat tinting and adaptive column widths.
desc.zh: 交叉汇总：可滚动、合计固定、悬停整行高亮、点击选中，度量可显示为占行/列/总计的百分比，支持热力着色与自适应列宽。

comps.name: TreeView

desc.en: Dir/file nodes with depth + checked flag.
Selected node index (two-way).
Clicking a box toggles a node (dirs cascade).
Returns checked leaf labels.
RenderChecked returns the right-clicked row for a menu.
Clicking a node updates selected.
Expandable dir/file tree with selection checkboxes, get-selected APIs and a right-click action menu.
desc.zh: 可展开的目录/文件树，带选择复选框、获取选中项 API 和右键操作菜单。

comps.name: Collapse

desc.en: Section title/body records.
Index of the expanded section.
Clicking a header sets the open index.
Display expandable sections controlled by a SignalInt open index.
desc.zh: 展示可折叠的分区，由 SignalInt 的展开索引控制。

desc.en: Month mode with agendas: click a day to select it (grayed adjacent-month days work too); the header and 今天 move months and report PanelChange.
desc.zh: month 模式带议程：点任一天选中（灰显的相邻月日期也可以）；头部与「今天」翻月并上报 PanelChange。

desc.en: Compact panel mode: one month grid with Today/Clear footer actions, for toolbars and sidebars.
desc.zh: panel 紧凑模式：单月网格加「今天/清除」底部操作，适合工具栏与侧栏。

desc.en: Selected date, YYYY-MM-DD; empty = none (GetExtra/SetProp).
month | panel.
Per-day agendas: AddMark(day, text, tone 0..4).
Delegate that disables days (naive-ui is-date-disabled).
Fires when the picked value changes.
Fires when the visible month moves.

A month calendar for picking dates and showing per-day agendas. Month mode is a full-bleed card: the header moves months (‹ title › plus a Today shortcut), the 7x6 grid fills the card and adjacent-month days render grayed but stay clickable; a day can carry up to two agenda marks (color dot + text, tone 0..4 = primary/info/success/warning/error). Panel mode is a compact month panel with Today/Clear footer actions. IsDateDisabled (a DateFilter delegate) dims and blocks days, mirroring naive-ui's is-date-disabled. Change fires when the picked value changes; PanelChange fires when the visible month moves.
desc.zh: 月历组件：用于选日期和展示每日议程。month 模式是整幅月历卡：头部 ‹ 年月 › 加「今天」快捷键翻转月份，7×6 网格撑满卡片，相邻月日期灰显但仍可点选；每天最多挂两条议程（色点+文本，tone 0..4 = primary/info/success/warning/error）。panel 模式是紧凑单月面板，底部「今天/清除」操作。IsDateDisabled（DateFilter 委托）禁用并阻塞日期，对应 naive-ui 的 is-date-disabled。点选值变化触发 Change，可见月份变化触发 PanelChange。

desc.en: Carousel.Of(slides, idx).RenderInside(app, rect) draws the current slide with arrows + dots; the index jumps instantly.
desc.zh: Carousel.Of(slides, idx).RenderInside(app, rect) 画当前页，带箭头与指示点；Index 双向绑定，索引立即跳转。

desc.en: The default way to show photos: AddSlideView embeds real Image controls -- each slide keeps the full address semantics (file / URL / data URI / SVG) while the carousel owns layout, cover-cropping and the slide transition. autoplay advances every 3s; hosts that rebuild per frame pass a host-owned SignalInt as the index (and the CarouselAnim) so the page number and the autoplay clock survive rebuilds.
desc.zh: 展示照片的默认方式：AddSlideView 内嵌真正的 Image 控件——每页保留完整地址语义（文件/URL/data URI/SVG），排布、cover 裁剪与滑动过渡归轮播。autoplay 每 3 秒自动翻页；每帧重建控件的宿主请把宿主持有的 SignalInt 作索引传入（连同 CarouselAnim），页码与计时才不会每帧归零。

desc.en: Direction("vertical") slides top-to-bottom: the arrows move to the top/bottom edges and point up/down; the transition travels along y. Works for text and control slides alike.
desc.zh: Direction("vertical") 纵向轮播：箭头移到上/下缘并朝上/下，过渡沿 y 轴滑动。文字页与控件页都适用。

desc.en: Any control can be a slide: AddSlideView accepts a Flex page with labels, an image+text row, or a page with a button -- the carousel arranges each to the full box, clips it, and animates it like any other slide.
desc.zh: 任何控件都能当页：AddSlideView 接受 Flex 排版的标题页、图文混排页、带按钮的交互页——轮播把每页摆满整个框、裁剪并参与过渡，与其余页面无异。

desc.en: The indicator dots scale to the slide count; the active dot widens. Handy for a gallery of images or steps.
desc.zh: 指示点随页数伸缩，当前页加长。适合图片墙或步骤条。

desc.en: dotPlacement moves the indicator dots: bottom (default), top, left or right -- here "left" stacks them vertically along the leading edge. The arrows stay put.
desc.zh: dotPlacement 移动指示点：bottom（默认）/ top / left / right——这里是 left，指示点沿左缘竖排。箭头位置不变。

desc.en: Slide labels (one panel each); control slides made with AddSlideView keep an empty label.
Active slide index (two-way).
Caller-owned slide-transition state (RenderAnimated).
horizontal | vertical -- slide axis; vertical moves the arrows to the top/bottom edges.
bottom | top | left | right -- where the indicator dots sit.
Advance to the next slide every intervalMs.
Autoplay interval in milliseconds.
Arrows / dots advance the active slide.

A slide panel with prev/next arrows and indicator dots, driven by a two-way active index. A page is a label (AddSlide) or ANY control (AddSlideView -- typically Image, so each slide keeps path / data URI / URL / SVG address semantics; panels of labels and buttons work too). Direction("vertical") slides top-to-bottom with the arrows moving to the top/bottom edges; dotPlacement moves the dots. Animate(anim) slides transitions via a host-owned CarouselAnim; autoplay advances every intervalMs. For an immersive full-screen viewer, wrap it in Layer.RenderPhotos.
desc.zh: 滑动面板：左右箭头 + 指示点，当前页是双向索引。一页可以是文字（AddSlide），也可以是任意控件（AddSlideView——典型是 Image：每页保留文件/data URI/URL/SVG 的地址语义；Label/Button 组成的面板也行）。Direction("vertical") 纵向滑动、箭头移到上/下缘；dotPlacement 移动指示点。Animate(anim) 用宿主持有的 CarouselAnim 播放过渡；autoplay 每 intervalMs 自动翻页。全屏沉浸看图可包进 Layer.RenderPhotos。

desc.en: A plain ticker at the default 48 px/s. Animate(hostAnim) keeps the phase alive across per-frame rebuilds of the control.
Short text repeats to fill the width (spacing = the style's gap) and the strip never blanks. Speed(80) doubles the default pace.
Skin classes restyle the strip: marquee.notice paints a soft primary bar with rounded corners (set height in the skin or via Prefer).
Scrolling text (re-read every frame).
Scroll speed in pixels per second (Naive UI speed).
Repeat the content to fill the width (Naive UI auto-fill).
Caller-owned scroll phase (Animate) for per-frame rebuilds.

A horizontal ticker: the text scrolls left at a constant speed (speed, in px/s, default 48) and loops seamlessly. With autoFill the content repeats to fill the width -- short text never shows a blank gap; otherwise one loop equals the strip width and the text re-enters from the right after scrolling fully out. The phase advances by wall time, so the speed is frame-rate independent; when the host rebuilds the control tree every frame, pass a host-owned MarqueeAnim via Animate() (same pattern as Carousel.Animate).
desc.zh: 水平跑马灯：文本以恒定速度向左滚动（speed，像素/秒，默认 48）并无缝循环。autoFill 时内容自动重复铺满可视宽，短文本也不会出现空档；否则一个循环等于可视宽，文本完全滚出后从右侧重新进入。相位按真实时间推进，速度与帧率无关；每帧重建控件树的宿主请通过 Animate() 传入一个宿主持有的 MarqueeAnim（与 Carousel.Animate 同一套路）。

desc.en: ECharts line1 dataset drawn plainly: five weekly traffic sources as polylines with the legend on -- click a chip to isolate one. The sibling 「ECharts · 标准折线图」 adds max/min markPoints and an average markLine on the same numbers.
desc.zh: 官方 line1 数据的朴素画法：一周五条流量来源折线并打开图例，点击色块可隔离系列；同数据的「ECharts · 标准折线图」示例再叠加最大/最小标注与均值标线。

desc.en: ECharts area-chart flavour over the official traffic-source set: three series fill vertical gradients under their lines, Monday through Sunday.
desc.zh: 官方流量来源数据的面积图画法（line3 风格）：三个系列在折线下方填充垂直渐变，周一至周日。

desc.en: o.smooth = true draws Catmull-Rom curved lines with a gradient area fill for a softer, LiveCharts-like look -- here an hour-by-hour price trace and its moving average.
desc.zh: o.smooth = true 用 Catmull-Rom 曲线绘制平滑线条并配合渐变面积填充，呈现更柔和的 LiveCharts 风格——这里展示逐小时价格轨迹及其移动平均线。

desc.en: ECharts bar1 weather pair drawn grouped bars with value labels on every top (文本标签). The sibling 「ECharts · 标准柱状图」 demonstrates the markPoint/markLayer overlay on the same months.
desc.zh: 官方 bar1 气象对照数据，每根柱顶标注数值（文本标签）；同数据的「ECharts · 标准柱状图」示例再演示最大/最小与均值标线。

desc.en: ChartSeries.StackedBar stacks the series per category into a single bar; different stackName values give side-by-side stack groups (ECharts stack) -- here a 5-source energy mix.
desc.zh: ChartSeries.StackedBar 将每个分类下的系列堆叠成一根柱；不同的 stackName 值产生并排的堆叠组（ECharts stack）——这里展示 5 源能源结构。

desc.en: ECharts line9 log axis: y-axis type=log renders exponential data as a straight line; ticks are powers of ten and only positive values are valid.
desc.zh: ECharts line9 对数轴：y 轴 type=log 把指数数据画成直线；刻度取 10 的幂，仅正值有效。

desc.en: ECharts line7 dual value axes: a connected series in scatter space maps both x and y by value, so point spacing follows the numbers instead of even categories.
desc.zh: ECharts line7 双数值轴：散点空间中的连线系列按数值映射 x 与 y，点距由数值决定而不是类目均分。

desc.en: ECharts radar1/radar2 side by side: the standard radar draws spokes only; setting areaStyle = true fills each series polygon semi-transparently. radarMax pins every axis to one scale.
desc.zh: ECharts radar1/radar2 并排：标准雷达只描线；设置 areaStyle = true 后每个系列多边形半透明填充。radarMax 统一各轴满刻度。

desc.en: ECharts chord1 standard chord diagram: node arcs split the rim by total flow and ribbon thickness scales with each link value -- nodes are derived from the link endpoints alone.
desc.zh: ECharts chord1 标准和弦图：外环节点弧按流量合计分宽，缎带粗细随链接值缩放——节点仅由链接端点推导。

desc.en: Component demo (legend): click any legend item to show/hide its series. Hidden state is kept per chart key across frames; the underlying data never changes.
desc.zh: 组件示例（legend）：点击任意图例项可切换该系列的显示/隐藏。隐藏状态按图表键跨帧保留，数据本身不变。

desc.en: Component demo (axis): name both axes, pick the tick count and toggle grid lines -- CategoryTitled/ValueTitled carry titles, ya.ticks sets the scale density.
desc.zh: 组件示例（axis）：为两轴命名、指定刻度数、开关网格线——CategoryTitled/ValueTitled 携带轴标题，ya.ticks 控制刻度密度。

desc.en: Parse a data document into a ChartOption (color 0 = auto palette) and render it -- no imperative calls. Ideal for server- or file-driven dashboards.
desc.zh: 将数据文档解析为 ChartOption（color 0 = 自动调色板）并渲染——无需任何命令式调用。非常适合服务端或文件驱动的仪表盘。

desc.en: Part-of-whole charts are compact, so lay them two-per-row instead of stretching one across the width. ChartSeries.Pie()/Donut() render each single-value series as a slice; the sweep grows in on first render and the donut prints the total in its hole. The two charts use different datasets so the pair reads as two examples, not one repeated.
desc.zh: 占比类图表很紧凑，因此每行放两个而不是把单个拉满整宽。ChartSeries.Pie()/Donut() 把每个单值系列渲染为一个扇区；首次渲染时扇区扫入生长，环图在中心打印总计。两个图表使用不同数据集，读起来是两个示例而非重复。

desc.en: A Gauge series owns its range, arc, layout, ticks, labels, pointer and detail text. Four colour stops divide the axis band, and the pointer animates into place.
desc.zh: 每个 Gauge 系列独立拥有量程、角度、布局、刻度、标签、指针和详情文本。四段颜色停止点划分轴环，指针随入场动画就位。

desc.en: Gauge geometry uses ECharts startAngle/endAngle and typed px/% values. Nested axisLine, pointer, title and detail entities own their styles.
desc.zh: 仪表盘几何使用 ECharts 的 startAngle/endAngle 与强类型 px/% 值；axisLine、pointer、title、detail 子实体分别拥有自己的样式。

desc.en: Several Gauge series share one content frame, laid out like a vehicle cluster: a small tachometer, the large speedometer and a small fuel/temperature dial. Percentage centers and radii place them; the frame widens automatically for multi-gauge options.
desc.zh: 多个 Gauge 系列共用一块画布，按汽车仪表组的小-大-小布局：小转速表、大车速表、小的油量/水温表。位置与半径用百分比给定，多表时画布自动变宽。

desc.en: A responsive dashboard composes four equally sized views chosen for the question: donut for revenue mix, radar for service balance, funnel for conversion and heatmap for time/channel intensity. It uses a 2x2 grid on wide cards and one column on narrow cards.
desc.zh: 响应式仪表盘按问题选择四种等尺寸视图：环形图看营收构成、雷达图看服务均衡、漏斗图看转化、热力图看时段与渠道强度。宽卡片使用 2×2 网格，窄卡片自动切换为单列。

desc.en: RadialBars renders concentric KPI progress rings. o.gaugeMax remains the shared full scale for this chart family.
desc.zh: RadialBars 渲染同心 KPI 进度环；该图表家族仍使用 o.gaugeMax 作为共享满量程。

desc.en: WordCloud renders named ChartData items as weighted keywords. Larger values receive larger type, and the deterministic spiral layout avoids overlaps while remaining stable between frames.
desc.zh: 字符云把具名 ChartData 实体按权重绘制为关键词。数值越大字号越大，确定性螺旋布局避免重叠，并在帧间保持稳定。

desc.en: A heatmap maps each series to a row and each value index to a column, colouring every cell by intensity (min->max ramps bgTertiary -> the series colour). Cells fade in with the intro animation. Good for calendars / correlation grids.
desc.zh: 热力图将每个系列映射为一行、每个值索引映射为一列，按强度为每个单元格着色（min->max 从 bgTertiary 渐变到系列颜色）。单元格随入场动画淡入。适合日历 / 相关性矩阵。

desc.en: A scatter series (ChartSeries.OfPoints) carries ChartPoint entities rendered on value axes. A Line series in the scatter space draws a connected polyline, so a linear-regression trend line can be fitted over the cloud; the second card is a 2000-point cloud served from the RenderCached snapshot (one pixel copy per frame) with live hover.
desc.zh: 散点系列（ChartSeries.OfPoints）携带 ChartPoint 实体列表，在数值轴上渲染。散点空间中的 Line 系列绘制连线折线，因此可在点云上拟合线性回归趋势线；右侧卡片是 2000 点的点云，由 RenderCached 快照提供（每帧一次像素拷贝），并带实时悬停。

desc.en: A GitHub-style contribution calendar: seven series (Mon..Sun) over 52 weeks fill a 7x52 grid; every series shares one green, so value intensity blends the layered greens of a contribution graph. Dense cells skip their labels automatically. Hover highlights the cell and shows the value.
desc.zh: GitHub 风格贡献日历：7 个系列（周一..周日）× 52 周填充 7x52 网格；所有系列共享一种绿色，值强度混合出贡献图的层次绿。密集单元格自动省略标签。悬停高亮单元格并显示数值。

desc.en: ChartSeries.StepLine draws staircase connectors (value holds then steps) -- good for discrete/state-over-time data.
desc.zh: ChartSeries.StepLine 绘制阶梯连接线（数值保持再阶跃）——适合离散 / 随时间变化状态的数据。

desc.en: ChartSeries.StackedArea stacks each series on the previous one as filled bands (cumulative).
desc.zh: ChartSeries.StackedArea 将每个系列叠加在前一个系列之上，形成填充带（累计）。

desc.en: ECharts line + stack: give a StackedLine series a stackName and every series sharing it stacks into one cumulative band with a top line (ECharts stack groups).
desc.zh: ECharts 折线 + 堆叠：给 StackedLine 系列设置 stackName，共享该名称的所有系列堆叠为一条带顶线的累计带（ECharts 堆叠组）。

desc.en: Financial OHLC bars from a List<Candle>. For huge histories the renderer buckets to plot width (first open / last close / bucket high-low), so a million bars still draw at O(width).
desc.zh: 由 List<Candle> 绘制的金融 OHLC K 线。对于超长历史，渲染器按绘图宽度分桶（首开盘 / 末收盘 / 桶内最高最低），一百万根 K 线仍以 O(宽度) 绘制。

desc.en: Weighted scatter from a List<Bubble> (x, y, weight); the bubble radius scales with sqrt(weight). Dense data is strided down to plot width.
desc.zh: 由 List<Bubble>（x, y, weight）绘制的加权散点；气泡半径按 sqrt(weight) 缩放。密集数据跨步降至绘图宽度。

desc.en: Box-and-whisker stats from a List<BoxItem> (lo, q1, median, q3, hi) -- box spans the quartiles, a line marks the median, whiskers reach min/max.
desc.zh: 由 List<BoxItem>（lo, q1, median, q3, hi）绘制的箱线图——箱体覆盖四分位距，中位数画线标记，须线延伸至最小/最大。

desc.en: Value +/- margin from a List<ErrorItem> (y, err): a line through the points plus vertical caps for the error range.
desc.zh: 由 List<ErrorItem>（y, err）绘制的数值 ± 误差棒：穿过各点的折线外加误差范围的垂直端帽。

desc.en: ChartSeries.Polar draws each series as a closed polygon over angular category spokes with concentric rings -- a radar/spider chart.
desc.zh: ChartSeries.Polar 将每个系列绘制为围绕角度分类辐条的闭合多边形，并带同心环——即雷达/蛛网图。

desc.en: Descending stages as centered trapezoids. Each single-value series is a stage (name + value); ChartSeries.Pyramid flips it narrow-at-top.
desc.zh: 逐级递减的居中梯形阶段。每个单值系列是一个阶段（name + value）；ChartSeries.Pyramid 翻转为顶部窄。

desc.en: ChartSeries.Rose gives every stage an equal angular sector whose radius scales with its value (a Nightingale rose diagram).
desc.zh: ChartSeries.Rose 给每个阶段相同的角度扇区，半径按值缩放（南丁格尔玫瑰图）。

desc.en: Second value axis: set a series axisIndex = 1 and add a ValueTitled axis with o.Y(); a line over bars is just mixed series types in the list.
desc.zh: 第二数值轴：将系列 axisIndex = 1 并用 o.Y() 添加带标题的数值轴；折线叠加柱状只是列表中混合系列类型而已。

desc.en: Fixed value bounds (ChartAxis.min/max) and a reversed axis (ChartAxis.reversed) so rank 1 sits at the top -- plus an axis title.
desc.zh: 固定数值边界（ChartAxis.min/max）和反转轴（ChartAxis.reversed），让第 1 名排在最上方——还带轴标题。

desc.en: Set o.zoom = true to get a range slider below the plot: drag either handle to resize the visible window or drag the band to pan. The window is kept per-chart, and only the selected categories are drawn. Click a legend swatch on any chart to show/hide that series.
desc.zh: 设置 o.zoom = true 可在绘图区下方获得范围滑块：拖动任一端手柄调整可见窗口，或拖动滑块条平移。窗口按图表独立保留，只绘制选中的分类。点击任意图表的图例色块可显示/隐藏该系列。

desc.en: o.markLine draws a labelled dashed threshold at a value; o.markLo / o.markHi shade a target band behind the series. Both map through the shared left axis.
desc.zh: o.markLine 在某个数值处绘制带标签的虚线阈值；o.markLo / o.markHi 在系列后方阴影出目标区间。两者都映射到共享的左轴。

desc.en: o.pieLabels = true draws each slice's share on the slice (in addition to the legend). Works for pie and donut.
desc.zh: o.pieLabels = true 在扇区上绘制各自的占比（图例之外）。饼图和环图均适用。

desc.en: Waterfall columns are deltas hanging from a running total, so rises and falls share one baseline; a data item named "total" draws the full running total as a subtotal bar (ECharts waterfall).
desc.zh: 瀑布图柱是挂在累计值上的增量，涨跌共享同一基线；名为 "total" 的数据项绘制完整累计值作为小计柱（ECharts 瀑布图）。

desc.en: Hierarchical data (ChartNode.Leaf / ChartNode.Group) rendered as nested rectangles; the split alternates direction per depth and group cells recurse when they are big enough.
desc.zh: 分层数据（ChartNode.Leaf / ChartNode.Group）渲染为嵌套矩形；每层深度交替切分方向，组单元格足够大时递归细分。

desc.en: ChartSeries.OfTreeOrient renders a layered node-link diagram from ChartNode data — ECharts type 'tree'. orient "vertical" stacks the levels downward with the leaves spread across the width; "horizontal" lays the levels left-to-right with leaves down the height. Broken orthogonal connectors join each node to its children.
desc.zh: ChartSeries.OfTreeOrient 用 ChartNode 数据渲染分层节点-连线图——ECharts 的 'tree' 类型。orient 为 "vertical" 时层级向下堆叠、叶子沿宽度展开；"horizontal" 时层级从左到右、叶子沿高度排列。节点到子节点用正交折线连接。

desc.en: Hierarchical data as concentric rings (ChartNode.Leaf / ChartNode.Group): each level is a ring, a group's children sweep its arc, and the center labels the root.
desc.zh: 分层数据的同心环展示（ChartNode.Leaf / ChartNode.Group）：每层是一个环，组的子项扫过其弧段，中心标注根节点。

desc.en: Directed flow links (ChartLink.Of(from, to, value)) between layered nodes; nodes are derived from the links, layer from longest-path, and link thickness scales with the flow value.
desc.zh: 分层节点间的有向流链接（ChartLink.Of(from, to, value)）；节点由链接推导，层级按最长路径，链接粗细随流量值缩放。

desc.en: ChartSeries.HBar flips the axes: categories run down the left, values across. A single series reads as a ranked list (ECharts bar3); give the series a shared stackName and the bands stack horizontally per row (ECharts bar4).
desc.zh: ChartSeries.HBar 翻转坐标轴：分类沿左侧向下排列，数值横向延伸。单一系列读作排名列表（ECharts bar3）；给系列共享 stackName 后，每行的条带水平堆叠（ECharts bar4）。

desc.en: The value axis auto-extends below 0 when any value is negative, and bars hang from the zero baseline (ECharts bar5). Per-item colours via ChartData.Colored split gains from losses.
desc.zh: 存在负值时数值轴自动下延到 0 以下，柱从零基线向下悬挂（ECharts bar5）。通过 ChartData.Colored 的逐项颜色区分盈利与亏损。

desc.en: Give StackedBar series a stackName and every series sharing it stacks into one column, while different stackName groups sit side by side -- ECharts' multi-stack bar (bar12).
desc.zh: 给 StackedBar 系列设置 stackName，共享名称的系列堆叠进同一根柱，不同 stackName 组并排摆放——ECharts 多堆叠柱（bar12）。

desc.en: Per-bar colours: build the series from ChartData.Colored items so each bar carries its own colour -- the data-item level of ECharts' three-level colour control (option < series < item).
desc.zh: 逐柱配色：用 ChartData.Colored 项构建系列，每根柱都有自己的颜色——ECharts 三级配色控制（option < series < item）的数据项级别。

desc.en: Series carry their own type, so one option mixes families: a line with a scatter overlay reads as trend + outliers (ECharts mix4), or bars with a moving-average line.
desc.zh: 系列自带类型，一个选项即可混搭图表族：折线叠加散点读作趋势 + 离群点（ECharts mix4），或柱状叠加移动平均线。

desc.en: The data window slides on a wall-clock beat and each paint re-arms app.RequestAnimationFrame, so the series scroll smoothly at ~30fps with no timer thread -- the ECharts dynamicLineBar look: a line with live bars sharing its axis.
desc.zh: 数据窗口按墙钟节拍滑动，每次绘制重新武装 app.RequestAnimationFrame，系列以约 30fps 平滑滚动且无需定时器线程——ECharts dynamicLineBar 观感：折线与实时柱共享同一坐标轴。

desc.en: A 4608-cell heatmap rendered through ChartView.RenderCached: the first frame rasterizes and snapshots it, later frames restore the cached pixels with one copy -- cost independent of cell count. Three live mini-charts beside it scroll on one shared RequestAnimationFrame. The status line shows Canvas.RasterStat (rounded-rect calls / restore calls / restore pixels).
desc.zh: 通过 ChartView.RenderCached 渲染的 4608 单元格热力图：首帧光栅化并快照，后续帧一次拷贝恢复缓存像素——成本与单元格数量无关。旁边三个动态迷你图由同一个 RequestAnimationFrame 驱动滚动。状态行显示 Canvas.RasterStat（圆角矩形调用 / 恢复调用 / 恢复像素）。

desc.en: ECharts-style ChartDataset holds named dimensions column-major once; each chart selects dimensions via EncodeNamed / EncodeBy -- no copying or reshaping. Here one dataset drives a grouped bar and an area chart.
desc.zh: ECharts 风格 ChartDataset 一次以列主序保存具名维度；每个图表通过 EncodeNamed / EncodeBy 选择维度——无需复制或重塑。这里一个数据集驱动分组柱状图和面积图。

desc.en: A 10,000-point line decimated to plot width by ChartBig: the first frame builds a cached min/max envelope (one column per pixel), every later frame redraws in O(width) regardless of point count. The left card shows a line + gradient area, the right a plain line.
desc.zh: 10,000 点折线由 ChartBig 降采样到绘图宽度：首帧构建缓存 min/max 包络（每像素一列），之后每帧按 O(宽度) 重画，与点数无关。左卡为线 + 渐变面积，右卡为纯折线。

desc.en: A 100,000-point trace that still draws at interactive cost: ChartBig decimates it to one min/max column per pixel and caches the envelope, so the frame cost is bounded by the widget width, not the series length. The caption prints the exact total.
desc.zh: 100,000 点轨迹仍以交互级成本绘制：ChartBig 将其降采样为每像素一列 min/max 并缓存包络，帧成本受绘图宽度而非序列长度约束。角标打印精确总点数。

  "series": [
    { "name": "telemetry", "type": "area", "count": 100000,
      "source": "raw List<int> virtual source, one flat int list" } ]
}

desc.en: Two 8,000-point windows scrolling over a 20,000-point ring buffer: Roll() advances an offset with zero data copying, and ChartState.Invalidate() rebuilds the envelope on the next frame, so the traces sweep smoothly at ~30fps.
desc.zh: 两条 8,000 点窗口在 20,000 点环形缓冲上滚动：Roll() 仅推进偏移量，零数据拷贝；ChartState.Invalidate() 使下一帧重建包络，轨迹以约 30fps 平滑扫动。

desc.en: Declarative config: title, axes, series (typed ChartSeries factories per kind). Build in code or via ChartOption.FromJson.
Each series carries its own type/color/axisIndex/stackName, so mixed charts are just a list.
Chart family from ChartType.* (Line/Area/Bar/StackedBar/HBar/Pie/Donut/Scatter).
Catmull-Rom curved lines (line family).
Vertical gradient fills for areas / bars.
Draw value labels on points / bar tops.
Hover crosshair + value tooltip (cartesian charts).
Grow-in intro animation on first render.

Declarative charts: one ChartOption carries the title, axes and every series (ChartSeries typed factories like ChartSeries.Line/Bar/StackedLine, or OfCandles/OfBubbles/OfBoxes/OfErrors/OfPoints for the multi-value families), then ChartView.Of(option).Render(app, x, y, w, h). The option model follows familiar chart conventions while retaining Zan-specific APIs. Data can be parsed from JSON (ChartOption.FromJson) so the same chart is code- or data-driven. ChartView plays a grow-in intro, draws gradient/smoothed series and an optional hover crosshair + value tooltip. Beyond the cartesian/pie basics it covers gauge, step line, stacked area, stacked line, candlestick (OHLC), bubble, box plot, error bars, polar/radar, funnel/pyramid, rose, waterfall, treemap, sunburst and sankey. Dense series decimate to plot width to stay fast on huge data.
desc.zh: 声明式图表：一个 ChartOption 携带标题、坐标轴和全部系列（ChartSeries 类型化工厂，如 Line/Bar/StackedLine，或多值家族的 OfCandles/OfBubbles/OfBoxes/OfErrors/OfPoints），然后调用 ChartView.Of(option).Render(app, x, y, w, h)。选项模型采用常见图表约定，同时保留 Zan 自身 API。数据可从 JSON 解析（ChartOption.FromJson），同一图表既可代码驱动也可数据驱动。ChartView 播放生长入场动画、绘制渐变/平滑系列和可选的悬停十字线与数值提示。除笛卡尔/饼图基础外，还覆盖仪表盘、阶梯折线、堆积面积、堆积折线、K 线（OHLC）、气泡、箱线、误差棒、极坐标/雷达、漏斗/金字塔、玫瑰、瀑布、矩形式树图、旭日图和桑基图。密集系列按绘图宽度降采样。

desc.zh: 下面每个按钮都在调真实 API。Layer.Msg 推顶部居中消息，Layer.Notify 推右上角通知卡；两者都会排队、自动消失并带收拢动画。宿主只需每帧调一次 Layer.RenderToasts / RenderNotifs。

desc.zh: 横幅文字。

desc.zh: StrokeWidth 以像素设轨道高度（Naive UI stroke-width）；0 用皮肤默认。

new Progress(72, 0).StrokeWidth(10);
new Progress(72, 0).StrokeWidth(20);

desc.zh: FillColor / RailColor 覆盖皮肤颜色（Naive UI color / rail-color）；0 恢复主题。

desc.zh: Format 重写百分比标签，模板里的每个 {0} 都会替换成数字（Naive UI indicator）。

desc.zh: Progress 切到 Ring() 画圆环仪表；Size() 以像素设直径。

new Progress(72, 0).Ring().RenderAt(app, 56, 36);
new Progress(90, 3).Ring().RenderAt(app, 156, 36);

desc.zh: Dashboard() 画 270 度仪表盘：弧从左下开始，底部留缺口。

desc.zh: Multi() 为每个 AddCircle(值, 类型) 画一圈，从最外层开始；中心按各环颜色逐行列出百分比。

demos.code: new Progress(0, 0).Multi().AddCircle(90, 3).AddCircle(60, 0).AddCircle(30, 2);

Colour: 0/1 default, 2 info, 3 success, 4 warning, 5 error.

Ring()/Multi()/Dashboard() switch the shape; Processing() rolls animated stripes over the fill while the task runs; FillColor()/RailColor() override the skin colours; Format() rewrites the percent label from a {0} template; Size() sets the ring diameter; StrokeWidth() sets the track height or ring thickness.
desc.zh: 四种形状的进度指示器：线性条、圆环、多圆环和 270 度仪表盘弧。type 选颜色（0/1 default，2 info，3 success，4 warning，5 error）。Ring()/Multi()/Dashboard() 切换形状；Processing() 在任务执行期间于填充上叠加滚动斜纹；FillColor()/RailColor() 覆盖皮肤颜色；Format() 用 {0} 模板重写百分比文本；Size() 设圆环直径；StrokeWidth() 设轨道高度或圆环厚度。

Top / Bottom / Left / Right (auto-flips near an edge).

Two-line bubble: bold title + muted description.

A floating hint anchored to a point. Four placements (Top/Bottom/Left/Right, auto-flipping near a screen edge), automatic word wrapping when a max width is given, a scrollbar when the wrapped text is taller than the height cap, and a two-line rich body (bold title + muted description) via RenderRich. Triggers: hover (Button.Tip), a click toggle, or fully manual caller state; widgets use the deferred RequestBox + frame-end Flush.
desc.zh: 锚定到某个点的浮动提示。四种方位（上/下/左/右，靠近屏幕边缘时自动翻转），给定最大宽度时自动换行，换行文本超过高度上限时显示滚动条，RenderRich 还能画两行富主体（粗体标题 + 弱化描述）。触发方式：悬浮（Button.Tip）、点击切换，或完全由调用方状态手动控制；组件内部走 RequestBox 延迟请求 + 帧末 Flush。

comps.name: Popover

desc.en: Heading.
Word-wrapped body text.
Panel width in px (clamped to the window).
Trigger toggles; outside press or Esc closes.

Retained popover. Owns its open state and paints in the overlay pass, so the panel draws above other content, blocks clicks to the widgets beneath it (no click-through), word-wraps its body, clamps to the window on every edge and closes on an outside press or Esc.
desc.zh: 保留态气泡卡片。自持展开状态并在覆盖层绘制，因此面板显示在其他内容之上，拦截对下方组件的点击（不穿透），正文自动换行，各边都会限制在窗口内，点击外部或按 Esc 关闭。

comps.name: Dropdown

desc.en: Trigger text while nothing is picked; a flat-mode pick takes over until Clear().
Flat entries: the picked index semantics match SelectBox.
Command tree: icons, separators, headers, disabled/danger, one submenu level; the trigger keeps the hint.
Visible rows before the menu scrolls (wheel and drag).
Drive the menu from caller state; Esc and an outside press also close it.
Menu mode: the leaf action picked last; -1 when nothing was picked.
Flat mode: the picked item (index -1 when nothing is picked).
Fires when a leaf is picked — run it and Clear().
The menu shows or hides, whatever the trigger.

Retained action menu. A click on the trigger (or a manual Open()/Close() from caller state) drops a menu of commands in the overlay pass: it always draws on top, blocks click-through, and closes on an outside press or Esc. Picking an item fires Change — run the command there and Clear() so the trigger returns to its hint. It is a command menu, not a value picker (that is SelectBox); BindMenu takes a MenuItem tree with icons, separators, group headers, disabled/danger items and a flyout submenu, and long menus scroll.
desc.zh: 保留态动作菜单。点击触发器（或由调用方 Open()/Close() 手动开合）在覆盖层弹出一组命令：始终显示在最上层、拦截穿透点击、点击外部或按 Esc 关闭。选中一项触发 Change——在处理器里执行命令并 Clear()，触发器回到提示语。它是命令菜单而不是选值控件（选值用 SelectBox）；BindMenu 接 MenuItem 树——图标、分隔线、分组标题、禁用/危险项和悬停展开的子菜单，长菜单自动出滚动条。

comps.name: Layer

desc.en: Queue a top-centered toast (auto-dismisses).
Queue a corner notification.
Masked spinner over a region.
Anchored tip bubble.
Full-screen carousel; true on close (X, mask click or Esc).
formType 0 text / 1 password / 2 multiline; initial value; maxLen in UTF-8 bytes.
Modal dialog: press+release on the shade (outside the box) reports action 2.
Embed a retained control tree (a form) as the window body; build it inside Layer.BeginBody()/EndBody() so ids come from the Layer reserved band.
Esc cancels the top dialog / closes photos, Enter confirms, arrows page photos. Render paths call it already; hosts may too.
Close by kind: 0 window, 1/2 dialog, -1 all; CloseLast falls back to a live photos layer.
1 default, 2 info, 3 success, 4 warning, 5 error.
Build a centered modal dialog; read state.action (1 OK, 2 cancel, 3 close).
Draw the z-ordered, draggable window stack.

The unified overlay component (layui `layer` style): one API for every popup. Message toasts and corner notifications are animated auto-dismissing queues that collapse upward; Alert / Confirm / Prompt are centered modal dialogs; Load is a masked spinner; Tips is an anchored bubble; draggable windows (min / max / restore / close) act as page layers; Photos is a full-screen image carousel. Every layer animates on open.
desc.zh: 统一的覆盖层组件（layui `layer` 风格）：一套 API 覆盖所有弹层。消息提示与角落通知是带动画、自动消失并向上收拢的队列；Alert / Confirm / Prompt 是居中的模态对话框；Load 是带遮罩的加载动画；Tips 是锚定的气泡；可拖动窗口（最小化 / 最大化 / 还原 / 关闭）作为页面层；Photos 是全屏图片轮播。每个弹层打开时都有动画。

Styles: Line, Card, Segment. Orientation: horizontal top strip or vertical side rail. Supports add (+), close, right-click context menu (Close / Close others / Close all) and horizontal overflow (mouse wheel + chevrons).
desc.zh: 保留态、自包含的标签组件。自持标签列表、当前索引和可关闭状态；只绘制头部标签栏，由调用方将当前页渲染到单独区域。样式：Line、Card、Segment。方向：顶部水平标签栏或侧边垂直标签栏。支持新增（+）、关闭、右键上下文菜单（关闭 / 关闭其他 / 关闭全部）以及水平溢出（鼠标滚轮 + 箭头）。

desc.zh: 在独立系统窗口中弹出的“打开/保存/选择文件夹”对话框。开启一个会话，在事件循环中转发它的窗口事件，再从 TakeResult() 读取所选路径。按 hwnd 把每个事件分派给对应窗口，这样对话框打开时父窗口仍可正常响应。

comps.name: ClickEvent

desc.en: Widgets expose C#-style events. Register handlers with the delegate += operator (lambda or method group); the handler fires from inside Render on the UI thread, so it is always safe to touch UI state -- no id polling. Use -= to remove one, or myEvent.Post() to raise from a worker thread (marshals each handler to the UI thread).
desc.zh: 组件暴露 C# 风格的事件。用委托 += 运算符注册处理器（lambda 或方法组）；处理器在 UI 线程的 Render 内触发，因此随时可安全操作 UI 状态，无需轮询 id。用 -= 移除，或用 myEvent.Post() 从工作线程触发（每个处理器都会封送回 UI 线程）。

comps.name: Events

desc.en: C#-style delegates and thread-safe events. A retained Button registers its handler once with  Click += StartTask; a background Thread reports progress back through app.Post, which runs the delegate on the UI thread (the Control.Invoke equivalent) so widget state is never touched off-thread.
desc.zh: C# 风格的委托与线程安全事件。保留态 Button 用 Click += StartTask 注册一次处理器；后台线程通过 app.Post 回报进度，委托在 UI 线程上执行（相当于 Control.Invoke），从而绝不在非 UI 线程操作组件状态。

desc.en: A simulated scan writes raw counts into four tags; the engineering text, the range percentage and the alarm state are all derived from those counts, and SetBad() marks a comms dropout without disturbing the last value.
desc.zh: 模拟采集向四个位号写入原始计数；工程值文本、量程百分比与报警状态都由计数派生，SetBad() 标记通信中断而不改动最后的数值。

demos.code:
TagTable io = new TagTable();
io.SetPeriod(500);                       // scan period (ms)

IoTag pv = io.Add("TIC101.PV", "°C", 10)  // scale 10 -> one decimal
              .Range(0, 3000)            // 0.0 .. 300.0 °C
              .Limits(500, 2500);        // LO / HI alarm limits
IoTag flow = io.Add("FIC102.PV", "m3/h", 10).Range(0, 5000);

// acquisition thread / timer:
io.Set("TIC101.PV", 1234);               // 123.4 °C
io.SetBad("FIC102.PV");                  // comms lost: keep value, drop trust

// display side:
string txt = pv.TextWithUnit();           // "123.4 °C"
int pct = pv.Percent();                   // 0..100 over the range
int al = pv.Alarm();                      // 0 none, 1 LO, 2 HI
int bad = io.AlarmCount();                // points currently in alarm

desc.en: Point name, e.g. "TIC101.PV".
desc.zh: 位号名，例如 "TIC101.PV"。

desc.en: Engineering unit shown after the value.
desc.zh: 工程单位，显示在数值之后。

desc.en: Counts per engineering unit: 1 integer, 10 one decimal, 100 two.
desc.zh: 每工程单位的计数：1 整数、10 一位小数、100 两位小数。

desc.en: Raw range used by gauges, bars and trends.
desc.zh: 原始量程，供仪表、棒图与趋势使用。

desc.en: LO / HI alarm limits; equal values disable limit checking.
desc.zh: 低 / 高报警限；两者相等表示不判限。

desc.en: Write a scanned value, or flag the point as untrusted.
desc.zh: 写入采集值，或把位号标记为不可信。

desc.en: 0 normal, 1 LO, 2 HI (always 0 without limits).
desc.zh: 0 正常、1 低报、2 高报（未设限时恒为 0）。

desc.en: Find or create on the fly, for data-driven screens.
desc.zh: 查找或即时建立，供数据驱动的画面使用。

desc.en: IoTag is one process point: a name, an engineering unit, a fixed-point value (raw counts + scale), a range and LO/HI alarm limits. Values are fixed-point integers -- scale 10 means one decimal -- because field ranges and limits are fixed-point anyway, and integers do not jitter on screen. TagTable owns the points for a screen: the acquisition side (Modbus / OPC / a serial thread) only writes, the display side only reads, and every gauge, readout, bar, trend and alarm binds to the same tag instead of holding a copy.
desc.zh: IoTag 就是一个过程位号：名称、工程单位、定点数值（原始计数 + 刻度）、量程与低/高报警限。数值用定点整数表示——scale=10 即一位小数——因为现场量程和限值本来就是定点的，且整数显示不抖动。TagTable 持有一幅画面的位号：采集侧（Modbus / OPC / 串口线程）只写，显示侧只读，所有仪表、数显、棒图、趋势和报警都绑定同一个位号而不是各存一份。

desc.en: Two tag-bound gauges (their arcs are split at the alarm limits, and the needle greys out when the point goes bad) and one plain gauge over a SignalInt with no tag at all.
desc.zh: 两个绑定位号的仪表（弧段按报警限分色，位号坏值时指针转灰），以及一个不绑位号、直接读 SignalInt 的仪表。

desc.en: The same data as a filled bar with limit marks: vertical by default, horizontal via Orient(Bargraph.Horizontal()). The bar turns blue on LO and red on HI.
desc.zh: 同样的数据以带限值标线的填充条呈现：默认竖向，用 Orient(Bargraph.Horizontal()) 转为横向。低报转蓝、高报转红。

desc.en: Label drawn under the dial / above the bar.
desc.zh: 画在表盘下方 / 条体上方的标题。

desc.en: Bound point; supplies value, scale, unit and range.
desc.zh: 绑定的位号；提供数值、刻度、单位与量程。

desc.en: Raw scale span of the arc / bar.
desc.zh: 弧段 / 条体的原始量程。

desc.en: Where the arc changes colour; equal values mean one normal band.
desc.zh: 弧段变色的位置；两者相等表示整弧为正常色。

desc.en: Bargraph only: Vertical() or Horizontal().
desc.zh: 仅棒图：Vertical() 或 Horizontal()。

desc.en: The raw-count signal being displayed.
desc.zh: 正在显示的原始计数信号。

desc.en: Re-point the widget at another tag at runtime.
desc.zh: 运行期把控件改绑到另一个位号。

desc.en: A 270-degree dial gauge with a scale arc, a needle and a digital readout, plus Bargraph -- the vertical/horizontal range bar of the same family. Both take a tag and colour themselves from its alarm limits (LO segment blue, normal green, HI red), so no colour bands need configuring; the needle also follows the tag's alarm state and quality. Trigonometry is fixed-point (SinDeg returns sin*1000), so drawing a needle pulls in no floating-point maths.
desc.zh: 270° 圆盘仪表：刻度弧 + 指针 + 数字读数；同族的 Bargraph 是竖向/横向的量程条。两者都接受位号并按其报警限自动着色（低报段蓝、正常段绿、高报段红），因此不必配置颜色区间；指针还跟随位号的报警状态与质量。三角函数为定点实现（SinDeg 返回 sin*1000），画指针不引入浮点依赖。

desc.en: Five lamps, one per state. WARN and FAULT opt into blinking with SetBlink(true) -- App's clock drives it, so the host needs no timer -- and COMM flips to red while the simulated scan drops out.
desc.zh: 五个状态各一盏灯。WARN 与 FAULT 用 SetBlink(true) 开启闪烁——由 App 的时钟驱动，宿主无需定时器——模拟采集中断时 COMM 转红。

desc.en: Four readouts bound to tags. Colour is the tag's alarm state (blue LO, red HI); the flow point periodically goes bad and prints "----" while keeping its last value.
desc.zh: 四个绑定位号的数显。颜色即位号的报警状态（蓝低报、红高报）；流量位号会周期性坏值并显示 "----"，同时保留最后的数值。

desc.en: Lamp / readout label.
desc.zh: 指示灯 / 数显的标题。

desc.en: Led state: 0 off, 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 blue.
desc.zh: Led 状态：0 灭、1 绿、2 黄、3 红、4 蓝。

desc.en: Led: blink while the state is 2 or 3.
desc.zh: Led：状态为 2 或 3 时闪烁。

desc.en: Digital: bound point (value, scale, unit, alarm, quality).
desc.zh: Digital：绑定的位号（数值、刻度、单位、报警、质量）。

desc.en: Write the lamp state (or drive its signal from a tag).
desc.zh: 写入指示灯状态（也可由位号驱动其信号）。

desc.en: Re-point the readout at another tag.
desc.zh: 把数显改绑到另一个位号。

desc.en: The two indicators every operator screen is covered in: Led, a glowing dot with a caption whose state is an int (0 off, 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 red, 4 blue) so it can bind straight to a tag and blink on alarm from App's animation clock; and Digital, the large numeric readout that switches to the alarm colour past a limit and prints "----" for a bad point.
desc.zh: 上位机画面上最常见的两个指示件：Led 是带标题的发光圆点，状态用整数（0 灭、1 绿、2 黄、3 红、4 蓝），因此可直接绑定位号，并借 App 的动画时钟在报警时闪烁；Digital 是大字号数显，超限转报警色，坏值时显示 "----"。

desc.en: Three pens over a shared 0..500.0 range, sampled on a 250 ms beat by the demo's scan. The grid labels are the fixed-point range formatted through the pens' scale, and the legend is drawn from the pen titles and colours.
desc.zh: 三笔曲线共享 0..500.0 量程，由示例的采集以 250 ms 节拍统一采样。网格标签是按曲线刻度格式化的定点量程，图例取自曲线标题与颜色。

desc.en: Chart title drawn top-left.
desc.zh: 画在左上角的标题。

desc.en: Shared raw range of the value axis.
desc.zh: 数值轴共享的原始量程。

desc.en: Samples per pen = width of the time window.
desc.zh: 每笔曲线的采样点数 = 时间窗宽度。

desc.en: Show the grid and its value labels.
desc.zh: 显示网格与数值标签。

desc.en: Adds a pen; the first one adopts the tag's range and scale.
desc.zh: 加一笔曲线；第一笔会跟随位号的量程与刻度。

desc.en: Pushes one point per pen into its ring buffer.
desc.zh: 为每笔曲线向环形缓冲推入一个点。

desc.en: A rolling real-time trend: several pens share one time axis and range, new samples enter from the right and old ones shift left. Each TrendPen keeps a fixed-capacity ring buffer, so a screen left running for days does not grow its memory -- the oldest sample is simply overwritten. Sampling is explicit (tr.Sample() from the screen's periodic timer), so all pens stay aligned on the same time base.
desc.zh: 实时滚动趋势：多笔曲线共享时间轴与量程，新点从右侧进入、旧点左移。每个 TrendPen 使用定容环形缓冲，因此画面连续运行数天也不增长内存——最旧的点直接被覆盖。采样是显式的（在画面周期定时器里调用 tr.Sample()），因此所有曲线严格对齐同一时基。

desc.en: The banner blinks at 400 ms for faults and 800 ms otherwise; its Ack button acknowledges the whole buffer and raises the Ack event. The two buttons raise records by hand, on top of the ones Scan() derives from the tag limits.
desc.zh: 横幅按故障级 400 ms、其它 800 ms 闪烁；确认按钮确认整个缓冲并触发 Ack 事件。两个按钮手工产生报警，与 Scan() 按位号限值派生的报警共存。

desc.en: Time / level / point / message / state, newest first, unacknowledged rows tinted with the priority colour. Clicking a row selects it and raises RowClick. It shares this page's buffer with the banner demo above.
desc.zh: 时间 / 级别 / 位号 / 描述 / 状态，最新在最上，未确认行以优先级色底显示。点击行即选中并触发 RowClick。它与上方横幅示例共用同一个缓冲区。

desc.en: Shared record store; swap it with Bind(buf).
desc.zh: 共享的记录存储；用 Bind(buf) 换绑。

desc.en: 0 INFO, 1 WARN, 2 FAULT -- decides colour and blink rate.
desc.zh: 0 提示、1 警告、2 故障——决定颜色与闪烁频率。

desc.en: AlarmBanner: the operator acknowledged the buffer.
desc.zh: AlarmBanner：操作员确认了缓冲区。

desc.en: AlarmList: the selected row changed (see SelectedItem()).
desc.zh: AlarmList：选中行变化（见 SelectedItem()）。

desc.en: Raise / clear records from the tag table's limits.
desc.zh: 按位号表的限值产生 / 复归报警记录。

desc.en: The alarm subsystem: AlarmBuffer holds the records (timestamp, point, message, priority, acknowledged, still-active) and can derive them itself with Scan(tagTable) -- a point past its limit raises one record, back inside clears it, so no alarm logic is hand-written per point. AlarmBanner shows the newest unacknowledged record and blinks until acked; AlarmList is the five-column log. Both take the same buffer, so acknowledging in one is visible in the other.
desc.zh: 报警子系统：AlarmBuffer 保存记录（时间、位号、描述、优先级、确认与是否仍成立），并可用 Scan(tagTable) 自行派生——位号越限产生一条、回到限内则复归，因此不必为每个位号手写报警逻辑。AlarmBanner 显示最新未确认记录并在确认前闪烁；AlarmList 是五列报警日志。两者接受同一个缓冲区，因此在一处确认另一处同步生效。

desc.en: Type a value and press ENT: the keypad writes TIC101.SV, and the readout beside it (plus the SV pen on the Trend page) follows immediately, because both read the same tag.
desc.zh: 输入数值后按 ENT：键盘写入 TIC101.SV，旁边的数显（以及 Trend 页的 SV 曲线）立即跟随，因为两者读的是同一个位号。

desc.en: Entry buffer (Text() / SetText() / Clear()).
desc.zh: 输入缓冲（Text() / SetText() / Clear()）。

desc.en: Point written on ENT; its current value is preloaded.
desc.zh: 按 ENT 时写入的位号；其当前值会被预置。

desc.en: Allow the +/- and decimal-point keys.
desc.zh: 允许 +/- 与小数点键。

desc.en: ENT pressed (after the value is committed).
desc.zh: 按下 ENT（在写入之后）。

desc.en: The keypad was dismissed.
desc.zh: 键盘被取消。

desc.en: An on-screen numeric keypad: industrial panels are touch screens with no physical keyboard, so setpoints are changed with this. It owns its entry buffer, and on ENT converts the typed text into raw counts through the target tag's scale before writing it -- "12.34" with scale 100 becomes 1234, extra decimals truncated and missing ones zero-filled. Enter / Cancel are events, so a host that wants to validate the value first can take over.
desc.zh: 屏幕数字键盘：工控机多为触摸屏、无实体键盘，改设定值靠它。键盘自己维护输入缓冲，按 ENT 时按目标位号的刻度把文本换算成原始计数再写入——"12.34" 配 scale=100 得 1234，多余小数截断、缺位补零。Enter / Cancel 是事件，宿主可接管以先做校验。

desc.en: Four devices in an auto-reflowing grid; one of them cycles through the five states so the chip and the left colour bar can be compared side by side. Narrow the window to watch the columns collapse.
desc.zh: 四台设备排在自适应网格里；其中一台在五种状态间循环，便于对照状态标签与左侧色条。把窗口收窄可看到列数自动减少。

desc.en: One card on its own, cycling through the five states. Its value rows read the tags straight, so a card holds no copy of the data and cannot go stale.
desc.zh: 单独一张卡片，在五种状态间循环。数值行直接读位号，因此卡片内没有数据副本，也不会显示过期值。

desc.en: Minimum card size in logical px; the column count follows it.
desc.zh: 卡片最小尺寸（逻辑 px）；列数据此推算。

desc.en: DeviceCard state: 0 stopped, 1 running, 2 alarm, 3 fault, 4 offline.
desc.zh: DeviceCard 状态：0 停机、1 运行、2 报警、3 故障、4 离线。

desc.en: Appends a device and returns its card (not Add: that adds children).
desc.zh: 追加一台设备并返回其卡片（不叫 Add：那是添加子控件）。

desc.en: Writes a device state by name; unknown names are a no-op.
desc.zh: 按名写设备状态；名称未知时为空操作。

desc.en: DeviceCard was clicked (open a device detail page).
desc.zh: 卡片被点击（一般用于打开设备详情）。

desc.en: The equipment wall: a container that reflows DeviceCard children into a card grid whose column count follows the available width, so widening the window just fits more cards per row instead of forcing a redesign. Each DeviceCard is a device name, a status chip and colour bar (0 stopped, 1 running, 2 alarm, 3 fault, 4 offline -- the same coding as Led) plus value rows that read their tags directly. Device names serialise as layout; the value rows stay code, because I/O is not layout.
desc.zh: 设备卡片墙：容器把 DeviceCard 子控件排成卡片网格，列数随可用宽度自适应，因此窗口拉宽只是每行多放几张卡，不必重新设计画面。每张 DeviceCard 是设备名 + 状态标签与色条（0 停机、1 运行、2 报警、3 故障、4 离线，与 Led 编码一致）加若干直接读位号的数值行。设备名可序列化为布局；数值行留在代码里——I/O 是代码，不是布局。
